name: Ndea
long_description:
Ndea is building frontier AI systems that blend intuitive pattern recognition and formal reasoning into a unified architecture.

# AI for Scientific Advancement

Unlike all life before us, humanity's ascent is a story of ingenuity, not just biological evolution. Our progress has been driven by the curiosity to acquire knowledge, the ability to pass it on, and an intrinsic drive to innovate. We build technology which gives us leverage beyond our biology.

We stand at the top of a knowledge and technology colossus that we collectively created over the past ten thousand generations. Scientific progress has helped us overcome burdens that long defined human life — famines, plagues, and widespread illiteracy. Science will continue to redefine the boundaries of the human condition.

Today, the acceleration of scientific progress hinges on one factor: AI capable of independent invention and discovery. This capacity is the gateway to advancements beyond our wildest imagination.

# A New Research Lab

We're starting Ndea — an AI research and science lab. The name - like 'idea' with an 'n' - is inspired by the Greek concepts ennoia (intuitive understanding) and dianoia (logical reasoning), capturing our first goal to merge deep learning with program synthesis.

Ndea is entirely focused on developing and operationalizing AGI to realize unprecedented scientific progress in our lifetime for the benefit of all current and future generations.

Building AGI alone is a monumental undertaking, but our mission is even bigger. We're creating a factory for rapid scientific advancement — a factory capable of inventing and commercializing N ideas.

From our vantage point today, we see many 'known' frontiers like self-driving vehicles, drug discovery, sustainable energy, robotics, and space exploration. While AGI will benefit all of these, the most exciting adventure lies in the 'unknown'. AGI promises discoveries and progress we cannot imagine today.
one_liner: Building AGI that can innovate.

name: ClaimGlide
long_description: We automate the entire end-to-end prior-authorization process for private practices for cheaper, and more accurately than they're doing today.
one_liner: AI automated prior-auths for private medical practices

name: Haladir
long_description: Haladir builds advanced AI systems for logistics. We sit on top of your WMS, TMS and ERP, turning their data into decisions across supply chain planning and execution: solver-grade optimization that decides what should happen, and AI agents that run the workflows. Today's AI brought intelligence. The next frontier is judgement.
one_liner: Operational Intelligence for Global Logistics

name: Linzumi
long_description:
Linzumi is the chat your engineering team uses to direct dozens of AI coding agents.

Kick off work, review it, ship it. All from chat.

See every agent's work. Unblock the agents that need you from your laptop, your phone, the coffee line. Your teammates see it too.

Every decision your team makes compiles into a source of truth - what to build, why it changed, how your agents should act. That same source generates new work and verifies completed work.

Deliberative alignment, repurposed from aligning LLMs to aligning companies.
one_liner: Team chat to command all your company's coding agents

name: Corvera
long_description:
Corvera (YC W26) is the AI sales agent for CPG brands. We turn the data a brand already has into the actions its sales team takes today.

A CPG brand sells into tens of thousands of independent US stores through dozens of distributors, and works that base with a handful of people. CLEAN Cause, a $20M yerba mate brand, covers 21,000 stores through 46 distributors with a four-person sales team. The accounts worth a call are not capped by headcount. The team is.

CLEAN Cause now runs its daily sales decisions on Corvera: 5,000 queries in 40 days across 12 users, $250K of opportunities surfaced within days, and a 7x return on the analysts they would otherwise hire.

With Corvera in place, every sales rep starts the morning with:
- The stores to act on today, ranked and priced, with the reason on the row,
- The outreach already drafted to the right contact at the right distributor, and
- The follow-up booked, logged, and measured against the goal it was set to move.

All from the distributor feeds, retailer portals, and ERP data they already have, resolved into one context layer - without a data team, and without handing their sales to a broker.

We’re founded by Chris (2x Founder; ex-CEO at Better Nature; Forbes 30U30), Dirk (ex-Google Data & AI Lead), and Matthew (ex-Head of Product at Rosemark; Princeton MEng in CS).

To date, we’ve raised $6.2M and are backed by YC, firstminute capital, 6 Degrees Capital, 20VC, Rebel Fund, Duke Capital Partners, and more. Our ICP is US CPG brands doing $20M+ in retail revenue through UNFI, KeHE and DSD distributors. We sell to VPs of Sales and CEOs.

The incumbents prove the scale. Brokers take 5-12% of a $350B US independent grocery market, and Advantage Solutions, a publicly traded company, does $3.5B in annual revenue.

Our mission is bold: to enable the next generation of unicorn CPG brands to be run by teams of less than 10 people.

Our vision is even bolder: to give every CPG brand the coverage of a full sales team at a fraction of the headcount, and displace the broker network that covers the US independent channel today.

Visit www.corvera.ai to learn more!
one_liner: The AI sales agent for CPG brands

name: Origin
long_description:
We produce patient-derived cancer datasets for licensing to pharmaceutical and AI companies. Our data comprises matched spatial transcriptomics, H&E and clinical labels. We operate our own laboratory, where samples are processed. Samples are sourced from leading biobank / hospital networks.

As R&D workflows increasingly rely on frontier AI systems, we believe there is critical need for real world datapoints so that findings translate in the clinic.
one_liner: AI and Data for Cancer Therapeutics

name: OneTriangle
long_description: Inference has surpassed training as AI’s largest compute cost, accelerated by increasing demand for AI and agents. By using proprietary KV cache transfer tech, OneTriangle has cut inference costs by 20% and time by 40% compared to present standards.
one_liner: The cheapest, fastest inference cloud

name: Imperfect
long_description: An adaptive training coach to help runners, cyclists, and triathletes set and achieve goals. It adapts your training, recovery, and nutrition to how your body is actually responding.
one_liner: Adaptive training coach for runners, cyclists, and triathletes

name: Quotient Labs
long_description:
You should only be paying frontier model prices for top-shelf reasoning. But 88% of your token bill is just tool I/O.
 Quotient Labs runs on top of Claude Code to reduce token spend, compress context, and optimize tool calls while preserving output quality. Same models, same workflow, no changes to how you work. Benchmarked 47% less cost on real, multi-step developer workflows, with no quality loss.
one_liner: Use Claude Code at 47% less cost in one line of installation.

name: RunAnywhere
long_description: RunAnywhere runs open-weight models at full speed wherever a company needs them. Wally is our inference stack for open models: serverless inference, BYOC, or on-prem, so code and data never leave their network. One command puts a Wally-served model inside Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, etc. When a model fits on the device, the same tooling runs it locally through our open-source SDKs for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and web, built on kernels written by our agentic harness for Apple and Qualcomm silicon (10K+ GitHub stars).
one_liner: Fastest inference anywhere: open models on-prem, hosted or on-device

name: 10x Science
long_description:
10x Science develops frontier AI models with deep memory to redefine how scientists understand and engineer biology across the life sciences, starting with drug development.

AI-powered drug discovery is flooding the pipeline with new candidates faster than ever. But before any of them can advance to the clinic, scientists must deeply characterize the protein therapeutic to understand whether it will work. Today, that process takes months of manual, error-prone analysis that cannot keep pace with discovery. Our AI-native platform automates it, giving drug developers the confidence to advance the right candidates and stop the wrong ones early.

We have strong commercial traction with enterprise pharma customers. Our founding team built the field of next-generation protein characterization out of Carolyn Bertozzi's Nobel laureate lab at Stanford. Collectively, we have 18+ years of collective domain expertise, 47+ scientific publications, and a 2x YC Founder. We move at the highest velocity and are positioned to lead the next generation of modern AI development in the life sciences.
one_liner: The AI-native platform for next-generation protein characterization.

name: Piris Labs
long_description: Up to 80% of the most advance AI compute chips sits idle because of slow networking. Piris Labs builds photonic based networking solutions to enable fast, scalable, and low cost AI workload execution infrastructure.
one_liner: The Networking Layer of AI

name: Skillsync
long_description: Skillsync makes your agent session history searchable. Both for you and your coding agents. It searches all your sessions before each prompt and hands your agent what you already figured out. It gives you one place for everything your agents have ever done. Move a full session between Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and any other agent with nothing lost, including the entire conversation, the model's reasoning, and every tool call, not just a summary, so the next agent picks up like it was there the whole time. Skillsync is local-first and yours, and its core engine, txcript, is open source, a portable session format that no single provider owns.
one_liner: Search your agent session history

name: Ashr
long_description:
Ashr Manifold is a self-contained model training, hosting, observability, and continual learning platform for purpose-built open-weight models. 

Startups can use Manifold to post-train and manage fleets of continuously improving open-weight models without having a dedicated research team or infrastructure. Ultimately, this reduces operating costs and allows a greater degree of control over proprietary company knowledge.

Enterprises can use Manifold to encode institutional judgements and priorities into open-weight models, reduce token costs, and manage every level of the AI life cycle, from data curation, to model serving on weights and infrastructure they own.
one_liner: Enterprise post-training, monitoring, and continual learning platform

name: RamAIn
long_description: RamAIn Employees join your team just like a human. Teach them to work across systems just like a new hire and watch them work autonomously to do the work 24/7.
one_liner: RamAIn - AI Employees with a computer to perform business tasks just…

name: Salus
long_description:
Your agent processed a refund without looking up the order ID, costing you thousands. You only found out three hours later from a support ticket. Evals, output scoring, and observability can reduce the likelihood of mistakes like these occurring - but there's no solution that inspects and prevents an action as it’s about to execute. Salus does that.

We’ve built an API that wraps around your agent and checks its actions at run time, blocking incorrect ones and providing immediate feedback to guide retries.
one_liner: Guardrails to validate your agent's actions before they execute

name: Q2Q
long_description:
Q2Q is the AI-native outbound engine for deal sourcing. Tell us the types of companies you want to buy, and we'll get qualified meetings booked for you. 

You can think of Q2Q as your personal team of AI interns. You give us your buying criteria, and we'll go out and find companies, write personalized emails, and get first calls booked with business owners for you. As the human in the loop, you'll approve messages before we send. Q2Q handles the sourcing work so you can focus on evaluating great deals.
one_liner: We help private equity teams find acquisition targets faster

name: Rapidfolio
long_description:
Rapidfolio helps banks and fintechs fully automate back-office workflows like fraud investigations, KYB/KYC and loan underwriting, with accuracy and auditability.

Built by fintech founders and operators, Rapidfolio is on a mission to ensure banks and fintechs scale their customer base without adding another back-office head count.
one_liner: AI-native back-office for banks and fintechs

name: IncidentFox
long_description: AI SRE agents that automatically learn each customer’s system so they work just like an in-house engineer.
one_liner: AI SRE agent that triages, coordinates, and fixes production incidents

name: Instinct
long_description:
Capital allocation is becoming a more important part of individual economic life.
Finance is moving toward a global, onchain, 24/7 future with thousands of markets trading at once.

The asset management industry is built around the scarcity of financial expertise and the cost of organizing people around capital. 

Institutions cover global markets by employing analysts, researchers, and quants around the clock. 

AI turns this organizational capacity into software.

Instinct is building the harness for this transition.

Instinct is a proactive team of agents that searches thousands of markets, investigates opportunities, and operates 24/7. The individual becomes the portfolio manager, Instinct becomes the investment firm operating around them.

As institutional advantages become widely accessible, the edge concentrates in each trader’s worldview, judgment, and bets. 

The first one-person investment firm managing $1 billion will emerge within two years.

It will run on Instinct.
one_liner: Trade with superhuman instinct

name: Overshoot
long_description:
Overshoot makes AI models run faster and cheaper on your hardware.

Serving engines like vLLM and SGLang were designed for the average workload. This results in most deployments being extremely inefficient, especially around throughput (hence cost). 

We profile your workload on your hardware, then build a custom deployment image tuned to the metrics you care about, within the quality limits you set.

You only pay if we meet the performance target we agree on.
one_liner: We optimize inference stacks for teams

name: Seeing Systems
long_description:
We engineer inexpensive, autonomous strike drones designed to operate in the most contested combat environments on Earth!

By combining true hardware modularity with an agentic control system that lowers cognitive load on operators, we enable faster upgrades, broader adoption, and more than 2x reduction in lifecycle cost.

Our customers and partners include the UK Royal Marine Commandos, several other units in the UK, and 4 other NATO forces, and we are currently shipping prototypes for iterative feedback.

Think of us as Anduril, but with worse weather, and better banter.
one_liner: Modular AI-Commanded Drones for Defence

name: Visibl Semiconductors
long_description:
Visibl Semiconductors makes custom silicon accessible to hardware companies, starting with power electronics. We are an AI-native custom-silicon design partner that cuts ASIC development cost and timeline on mature nodes, helping teams deliver better performance and lower BOM cost.

We work with data-center and AI-infrastructure power, motor drives, industrial automation and robotics, industrial power supplies and conversion, battery systems and e-mobility powertrains, EV charging, solar, energy storage, grid power, HVAC, heat pumps, and appliances.

V1 boards built from off-the-shelf parts are great for getting to market quickly, but scaling to v2+ volume requires optimizing cost, size, and manufacturability. Visibl folds those parts into custom silicon built around the product: a simpler BOM, reclaimed board space, fewer supply constraints, and automation-ready assembly.

We manage the full path from architecture and design through verification, fabrication, packaging, and production-ready silicon, working alongside hardware teams so they do not need an in-house chip team.
one_liner: Custom silicon for power electronics

name: Assemble
long_description: Assemble accelerates IT teams by performing development work inside core enterprise systems like ERP, CRM, and HRIS. Our agents help IT teams scope dependencies, build logic, and validate changes across your systems.
one_liner: Autonomous IT Delivery

Sitefire identifies which content drives AI visibility, and automatically creates it. The teams using Sitefire execute on-page and off-page actions to deliver measurable top-line growth.
one_liner: Marketing suite for the agentic web

name: Bubble Lab
long_description:
Bubble Lab helps event organizers and professional communities turn a room full of people into meaningful connections. We help them understand who’s in the room, identify who should meet, make the introduction, and remember those relationships for the next event.

Attendee enrichment, matchmaking, searchable member directories, applications, payments, Luma and Slack sync, onboarding, and analytics all live in one place, so a single operator can run better gatherings and build a smarter community over time.
one_liner: Turn gatherings into lasting relationships.

long_description: Archal provisions sandboxes with the API environments your CI, tests, and evals need. Your coding agent can start the sandbox & environments, connect to your API integrations, run tests, and inspect state changes. Sandboxes and environments are startable within seconds and take milliseconds to reset.
one_liner: API sandboxes, built for AI agents

name: Voxel Energy
long_description:
The best grid connection is no grid connection. Voxel builds vertically integrated energy generation and storage systems for data centers that bypass utility connection delays. 

By leveraging the vast supply of second-life EV batteries and our novel DC microgrid architecture, Voxel generates datacenter power on site and drastically reduces system cost and time-to-power.
one_liner: Energy independent data centers with solar and repurposed batteries.

name: Paradev (formerly Superset)
long_description:
Paradev (formerly Superset) is an open-source IDE that helps engineers run 100s of coding agents in parallel.

Our desktop app is loved by tens of thousands of engineers, and we're scaling out our effort to build a collaborative, cross-platform tool to allow users to code anywhere.
one_liner: Building self-improving software

name: Datoric
long_description:
Datoric develops custom datasets for robotics, treating research, collection, verification, and production as one continuous process. We work closely with frontier model teams to turn emerging limitations and model failures into testable data hypotheses, and run exclusive collections for specific data methods based on results.

Data is collected through private invite-only applications separated by modality, customer, and trust level. Every submission remains linked to the contributor, device, task, session, consent, rights, and processing history that produced it, giving our internal QA and fraud models the context to detect problems that may appear legitimate in the finished file. 

Once a collection method is validated, we scale it up as a solution to the model failure and it also becomes a reusable data recipe for future custom projects or independently collected, rights-cleared data products.
one_liner: The training data R&D engine for physical AI

name: Servo7
long_description:
We deploy robots in warehouses to automate the most demanding job in logistics: unloading loose-loaded containers.

Our customers include 3PLs (CEVA, Stord), distributors (DHL, PostNL) and many more logistics companies.
one_liner: Container unloading robots for warehouses

name: Libra Robotics
long_description: Infrastructure faces rapid expansion and labor shortages. Today, robots struggle to scale to meet customers’ high-mix work needs. Libra builds AI that engineers robots for new tasks across embodiments. We go from each new infra task to field-deployable robots 10x faster. Today, our robots are working on solar farms and piloting in data centers. Contractors pay for completed work as a service, not robots.
one_liner: The robot workforce for infrastructure of the AI era

name: o11
long_description:
o11 helps your AI agents access apis, tools, and other paid goods and services. Instead of hacky computer use, managing credit card permissions, assigning each agent a new email, we handle all the hard parts of accessing the paid web. o11 has zero markup and gives teams better prices, easy checkout, and full auditability when purchasing with AI agents. 

The o11 wallet gives your AI agents access to the paid world.
one_liner: OpenRouter wallet for paid goods and services

name: Corelayer
long_description:
Corelayer is the AI-native platform for production software support, built for regulated industries like finance and healthcare. It continuously monitors alerts, logs, infrastructure, and underlying data for issues and uses agents to debug and suggest fixes.

We're helping SRE, production services, and on-call engineers at companies ranging from growth-stage fintechs to Fortune 500 financial institutions spend less time on support and more on high-leverage work.
one_liner: AI production engineer for regulated industries

name: Foreman
long_description:
Foreman is the all-in-one AI-powered project management platform built for construction contractors and the trade industry.
Today, contractors run complex businesses on a patchwork of tools that were never designed for construction — estimates in spreadsheets, plans in email, proposals copy-pasted from old Word docs, photos scattered across phones. Nothing talks to anything else, and the admin work never stops.
Foreman replaces that patchwork with a single platform that manages the full lifecycle of a construction job, from first estimate to final invoice. Contractors upload plans, photos, or a project description, and Foreman's AI instantly generates structured takeoffs, scoped estimates, and professional proposals — in minutes, not hours. From there, every customer record, document, permit, photo, change order, and conversation lives in one place, organized around the job.
The result: contractors spend less time buried in admin and more time building. They bid faster, manage jobs with less chaos, and close projects cleanly — without duct-taping five tools together to do it.
one_liner: Keeping contractors on the job site, not behind a desk.

name: Turnstone
long_description:
Turnstone is the AI workspace where your agents already know you. Connect your apps (e.g. email, calendar, Slack, Drive) and your local folders. Turnstone turns all of it into your second brain and continuously updates it.

Spin up agents (e.g. chief of staff, research, GTM) that all share that brain, so you stop re-explaining yourself and start getting real work done.

It all lives on your machine and runs on any model you already pay for. Ask your agent once, and it's done.
one_liner: Work with agents that already know you

name: Inth
long_description:
Inth monitors your pull requests, codebase and website to catch privacy issues and turns them into fixes and evidence.

Every product change you make exposes you to privacy risk. Customers lose trust. Fines and lawsuits are given. Fundraising and customer deals are broken. New market launches halt.

The growth you thought you would have slows because privacy compliance is overwhelming and changes with every product update.

Inth is fixing this to help you automate privacy compliance to ship and grow faster.

Inth scans your PRs, website and codebase to catch any privacy risk. It then fixes and evidences them against your product, policies and global privacy laws to automate privacy compliance in every region your customers are in.

Start a free privacy scan at: inth.com
one_liner: Monitor and fix product privacy issues before they block growth

name: Grade
long_description: Grade is the API for performance-based payroll. Think of us like Deel or Gusto, but our payouts are for work completed, not hours. Companies use Grade to pay AI agents and contractors based on results: tasks completed, targets hit, work delivered. We handle compliance, tax reporting, and global payouts.
one_liner: API for performance-based payroll

name: Atlia
long_description: We use AI agents to manage short-term rental properties by running operations completely autonomously. We cut traditional human management fees in half so owners take home 20% to 30% more revenue. And we operate with near-zero boots-on-the-ground so we can scale nationwide with software margins and at venture speed in a traditionally physical industry.
one_liner: The AI-native property management company for short-term rentals
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

name: Dream
long_description:
Dream makes AI cameras that catch damage teams miss. Car dealerships, equipment rental companies, fleets, and more move expensive assets in and out all day, and undocumented damage is a costly leak.

Dream cameras are simple to set up and work automatically. Each vehicle or machine that passes is photographed from every angle, identified, and reconstructed into a complete condition record. On return or intake, Dream instantly flags new dents, scrapes, and changes your team might miss, giving one source of truth for every asset's condition over time.

Ryland worked at X/xAI and built aerial damage-detection vision at Vexcel Imaging. Alexander worked at AWS and trained edge-camera models deployed in the wild across Africa and India to detect poachers.
one_liner: Using VLMs to Catch Damage

name: Tsenta
long_description:
Tsenta is an AI career agent that matches you with jobs, applies automatically, and gets you the best offers on the market.

We grew to ~$3M Annualized in three months. 

We built it after manually applying to over 3,000 jobs ourselves, so that candidates would always have someone on their side.

Today, more than 90,000+ job seekers trust Tsenta to automate their job search.
one_liner: AI career agent that finds matching jobs & applies on your behalf

name: Talking Computers
long_description:
AI lab building interaction models to make AI symbiotic with humans.

Our early models sit at the Pareto frontier of intelligence and interactivity, measured by time to first audio token, and enable voice agents that are both highly capable and genuinely human-like
one_liner: Real-time interaction models for voice agents

name: Veriad
long_description: Veriad is building marketing agents for enterprises to run advertising campaigns end-to-end in-house.
one_liner: AI operating system for advertising

name: Cova
long_description: Millions of Americans already care for someone they love. We're building a world where they can get paid for it, with the technology to make the process simple, the support to help them provide better care, and a model that gives more back to those doing the real work.
one_liner: Financial infrastructure for family caregiving

name: Poth Labs
long_description: Poth is an agentic research platform that connects to your company data, creates hypotheses about what might be causing problems, and validates them using both existing data and adaptive user feedback.
one_liner: The customer brain that connects data to explain customer behavior

name: TensorTest
long_description:
TensorTest (formerly Ritivel) builds evaluations, reinforcement-learning environments, and expert training data for AI labs developing creative agents, starting with video editing.

An agent can produce a valid video file without delivering an edit that meets the client’s brief. Labs need reliable ways to measure creative quality, identify failures, and give agents feedback they can learn from.

Our first benchmark, TimelineBench, gives agents client video-editing jobs with raw footage, audio, and a brief. It evaluates the finished work using a verifier calibrated on thousands of blind judgments from professional editors. Across 16 agents we tested, the best passed only 26.8% of jobs. Most failures came down to creative craft rather than broken output.

We offer labs private evaluations to identify where their models fail, training environments that use our verifier’s scores as rewards, and expert-created training data, including professional editing demonstrations, preference pairs, and grading rubrics. These offerings connect evaluation to training: identify what an agent gets wrong, provide feedback on its attempts, and supply examples of better work.

Our team comes from IIT Bombay and has trained language models and built agentic systems at Microsoft Research.
one_liner: Evals, RL environments and training data for creative tasks

name: Dipole Labs
one_liner: AI-controlled optical switching for AI clusters

name: Ossus
long_description:
We build intelligence for cultural institutions.

Our first commercial product is for the literature industry with a focus on school and public libraries. It is a AI-native OS for libraries, that helps librarians save time on tedious tasks and lets them focus on their patrons.
one_liner: Intelligence for cultural institutions

name: Carrot Labs
long_description:
The problem: 
AI has quietly become one of the largest and fastest-growing line items for companies. Spend is scattered across a dozen provider consoles that each show one number at the end of the month and nothing about why it moved. There's no unified view, and no way to trace a dollar back to the customer, feature, team, or even the pull request that caused it.

Which customers are unprofitable once you subtract their AI costs? Which feature is quietly burning your Anthropic budget? Is this week's spike a runaway loop or real growth? How much did that AI-written PR actually cost to ship?
Today teams reverse-engineer answers by exporting CSVs from each provider and stitching them together in a spreadsheet, and by the time they do, the money is already spent.

What SuperPenguin does: SuperPenguin tracks AI spend across 14 providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, AWS Bedrock, Azure, Modal, Cursor, OpenRouter, and more).

* Zero-code setup: connect an API key and costs sync automatically with model-level breakdowns, trends, and forecasts
* Per-request attribution: add two lines with our Python or TypeScript SDK to tag every AI call by customer, feature, team, or environment (or any other metadata).
* AI coding cost per PR: connect Cursor to see engineering spend attributed to each pull request, repo, and developer, so you know what it actually costs to ship.
* Alerts on budget thresholds and spend anomalies, delivered to Slack, email, or Discord.

Most teams are set up in under five minutes. We help companies see where their AI money goes and whether it's worth it.
one_liner: AI Cost Management: Track and attribute AI spend across every provider

name: Shofo
long_description:
We are building the world’s largest video library. We've aggregated billions of videos into a searchable index and use agents to find and label the exact datasets a lab needs on demand.

If a lab needs 100K hours of cooking videos where someone is holding a pan, with reasoning annotations on top, our agents search the index, extract the matching subset, route it through our labeling pipeline, and deliver a custom dataset in days, not months.
one_liner: The World's Largest Video Library

name: Litmus
long_description:
Litmus is building the most accurate framework for evaluating and benchmarking human capability, starting with software.

AI will compound small differences in human capability into increasingly large differences in what people can accomplish, while making existing static benchmarks obsolete. Software is already there: AI can hill-climb any output-based evaluation, while the ability to direct it is becoming the defining advantage. 

Litmus applies the same approach we already use for model evals to humans – creating world-like environments, and inspecting trajectory instead of just output.

Every knowledge industry will soon face the same problem. We build Litmus to tell you what humans are capable of.

We're already helping build frontier technical teams at Mercor, Composio, Neo Scholars, and more.
one_liner: Evals for humans

name: Databuddy
long_description:
Databuddy gives you your very own data analyst, always watching over your data, combining all your context to investigate and paint a full picture on every product issue that emerges in real-time; conversion drops, user frustration and churn.

It makes your product better without needing to have you look at a dashboard and spend hours figuring out the why. one click to install or switch from any dated analytics provider.
one_liner: AI Data Analyst for fast-growing teams

name: Hedge
long_description: Hedge is an AI-Native specialty insurance company. We help insurance brokers find faster, cheaper, and better coverage for their customers.
one_liner: AI-Native insurance company

name: Korso
long_description: reach out to find out more: https://cal.com/korso-founders/15min

name: PerfectBit, Inc.
long_description: PerfectBit builds learned policies for robots that do real work. We train manipulation and control policies that hold up outside the lab, in the unstructured environments where real tasks actually happen. Founded by two alumni of Meta's Superintelligence org: Péter Vajda led Media GenAI foundation-model R&D (Emu, Movie Gen, image and video editing), and Seiji Yamamoto led teams in the Core Llama group across LLM pre-training and post-training, inference optimization, and computer vision. We're early, deliberately quiet about the details, and hiring the first researchers who will shape what this becomes. San Francisco, on-site.

name: Illume Labs
long_description: Illume is a 24/7 AI personal health & longevity companion that connects your wearables, blood panels, and genomic data to text you personalized and actionable insights. We pull in your health data and fuse it into one secure model. You get daily text updates on what changed, what it means, and what to do next; conversational health Q&A like "What should I do to improve my bloodwork?"; cross-data trend detection that catches patterns individual platforms miss; and a full platform to dig deeper, explore your health data, and text your Illume agent anytime. We're 3 MIT grads & friends, with experience at Windsurf, MIT CSAIL, Eli Lilly, & the Broad Institute.
one_liner: 24/7 Personal Health & Longevity Companion

name: Most Robotic

We're MIT computer scientists & friends since middle school, with robotics research backgrounds and industry experience at NASA JPL, SpaceX, and AWS.

name: Multiplier
long_description:
Multiplier helps institutional investors research stocks and manage their portfolios. We're live with six hedge funds, and our users spend 4+ hours a day in the platform.

Investors who try "nearly every tool on the market," to quote a client of ours, "wind up with an unwieldy collection of fragmented point solutions." Those who focus on building a great setup with general agents are instead "signing up for a full-time job." So we deploy a platform called Multiplier that unifies structured data, unstructured data, AI work, human work, and tacit firm knowledge in one secure, governed, customized application.

Our first vertical: independent equity funds with $250M-$5B of assets. They know AI is essential for staying relevant, but they don't have the time or talent to figure out what to do about it. But once we deploy Multiplier––"We used to spend 80% of our time gathering information and 20% of our time acting on it," said one customer. "Multiplier has flipped those percentages."
one_liner: Agent harnesses for asset managers

name: Palette
long_description: Palette is a self-improving AI-native media platform built by MIT computer scientists and multimodal researchers that unifies the creative workflow into a single generation engine. We’re building a fully autonomous production engine that generates, distributes, and optimizes interactive media for every brand and audience.

long_description: Marker is a platform for rebuilding enterprises agent-first, delivered by forward-deployed engineers. It productizes every step from discovery to production, so every agent we ship makes the next one faster.

name: Twolabs
long_description:
We build verifiable reinforcement-learning environments, evaluations, and proprietary training datasets to improve frontier AI models and robot policies.

We focus on complex, underexplored domains like PCB and chip design, embedded systems, robotics, and specialized coding environments, where high-quality training data is scarce and existing models fall short.

Our long-term goal is to develop self-improving training infrastructure that can autonomously generate increasingly challenging tasks, evaluate performance, and continuously advance model capabilities toward recursive self-improvement.

name: Discovered Materials
long_description:
We use AI to discover new materials for the semiconductor industry - specifically datacenters and fabs. Finding novel materials today takes 10+ years of lab work. We aim to compress that timeline to months, using a swarm of AI agents.

Akash completed his PhD at Stanford on material discovery for semiconductors. The materials he discovered for nanoscale interconnects have been adopted into the roadmaps of Intel and TSMC. Advaith was the founding applied scientist at Persona AI (acquired by Luma Labs), where he built long horizon autonomous agents for major telecom and crypto companies.

Power consumption and heat release from AI chips is doubling every year. The semiconductor industry needs new materials to keep this exponential going -  Discovered Materials will help find them.
one_liner: AI scientists to discover materials for the semiconductor industry.

name: Hub
long_description: Hub is a multimodal lab providing real world data to frontier labs and robotic companies.

name: Light Anchor
long_description:
Light Anchor (YC P26) is an AI-native growth agency for consumer brands.

Consumer brands have always been limited by the speed of humans: hiring, coordinating, and sleeping. AI agents that now run operations end-to-end break all those constraints, making a new kind of consumer business possible: one capped by compute, not headcount.

Today, Light Anchor operates 7 brands, all run by AI agents on a shared platform that compounds with every new brand launched. The vision is thousands of consumer businesses, operating with little to no human intervention.
one_liner: AI-native growth agency for consumer brands

name: GodHands
long_description: GodHands learns how your teams actually work from the apps they already use, capturing the steps, decisions and exceptions that never get written down. It turns them into knowledge and playbooks, gives people and AI agents the answers, and builds agents that do the work the same way. Teams use GodHands to run operations, onboard new hires, hand over roles, integrate acquisitions and automate repetitive work.
one_liner: Turn how your team works into playbooks and agents.

name: Superlog
long_description:
Sentry and Datadog dump a stream of alerts. Most are duplicates, most lack context, and you still have to solve the issue yourself.

Superlog is AI-native observability that's meant not to be opened. A wizard scans your repo and installs proper OpenTelemetry instrumentation, then runs daily to keep up as you ship new code. When something breaks, Superlog groups the errors into a single incident, investigates with full context (logs, traces, recent deploys, past Slack threads), and posts one mergeable PR in Slack. You merge it, ignore it, or open it as a Claude Code session and modify it.

Telemetry is vendor-neutral, so you keep every log, trace, and metric we install, even if you leave.
one_liner: Make software self-healing

name: Deep Interactions
long_description: Deep Interactions is a collaborative AI builder. We don't leave you with a spaghetti mess of a code. We bring product intelligence and power the context layer that enables your team to build in sync - saving companies tokens, time, and nerves. You give us a problem and we ship a working AI product in the same afternoon.

name: BayMachines
long_description: BayMachines deploys on-prem, air-gapped GPU systems for defense teams to run and fine-tune AI locally. We support defense technology companies serving the DoW and special operations, with deployments built to support CMMC and NIST 800-171 requirements.
one_liner: AI compute for defense contractors

name: Userlens
long_description:
Companies today are growing faster than ever with smaller teams. The best AI-native companies don’t just need more users - they need more of their users becoming power users. Userlens makes it possible for lean teams to drive product adoption proactively, at scale.

Userlens is building the AI product adoption expert. Our goal is to help every user at every company get more value from the product they already use.

Most teams still rely on onboarding flows, lifecycle emails, support docs, and reactive CSM outreach. Userlens breaks that ceiling. Lumi watches how users actually use your product, spots when they’re ready for the next feature, workflow, or habit, and nudges them at exactly the right moment.
one_liner: Let agents talk to your customers

name: Antinuous
long_description:
Antinuous is building autonomous research agents to help people in research, development, discovery, and knowledge work do faster, more accurate research end to end without a human in the loop.

We believe humans should be able to ask a single question, and no matter how simple or complex, agents should look at the question, break it down, research the answer, test new ideas, simulate new environments, and repeat autonomously using as much or little compute as necessary elastically.
one_liner: Autonomous research agents for R&D and applied science

name: StableBrowse

name: Kimpton
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
long_description:
In investment management, every decision gets graded. The market prints the answer on a date known in advance, and nobody gets to argue with it.

Kimpton is financial AI that answers to reality. Kimpton OS is the AI-native operating system for investment teams: it does the research and hands PMs structured trades. EarningsBench is a public benchmark where models forecast quarterly earnings before companies report and the reported numbers do the scoring. Koliseum is the set of point-in-time financial environments we build from that work, for labs to train and evaluate models on.

The whole industry is fighting underperformance. Active managers trail their benchmarks, and capital keeps bleeding into passive. AI was supposed to fix that, but it hasn't. Funds either stitch together a dozen point tools or babysit general agents all day, and neither gets them to the trade.

Kimpton OS goes straight to it. It ingests a fund's mandate, strategy, and positions, connects to the institutional data the fund already runs on, and returns a structured trade proposal built for that fund. It's built to disagree, because consensus is poison for investment decisions. Instead of telling a PM what they want to hear, it surfaces the breaches and risks they'd otherwise miss.

That same work is how we grade AI. Static benchmarks leak into training data. Simulations reward what their authors imagined. A forecast sealed before the outcome exists and scored when the company reports can't be rehearsed or backdated. We started in markets because they're the one place reality answers on schedule.

We're two ex-Goldman engineers and an ex-SpaceX engineer. We left to start our own quantitative systematic hedge fund, raised $10M from a family office at 21 and 22, and scaled it to $35M over four years. We learned to trust live results over historical fit. We built Kimpton inside that fund, then productized the stack.

We're live with our first institutional client, a $3.3B manager. Our first market is fundamental equity funds from $1B to $10B, and the labs that need to know whether their models can do this work.
one_liner: Live Evaluation Arenas for Financial Work

Lab0 builds agentic systems that automate this layer, compressing months-long implementations into weeks.

name: Masterpiece
long_description:
We believe AI will be one of humanity’s next great masterpieces. Building it will require financial infrastructure as ambitious as the companies creating it. We're founders backed by Y Combinator building the financial rails underpinning the AI data economy.

Masterpiece provides short term working capital to data vendors that sell training data, evaluation work, and reinforcement learning environments to frontier AI labs.

A major financing gap exists in this market. Data vendors often need to pay contributors and fund operations before a lab has completed QA, accepted the work, and paid the invoice. This creates a 30 to 90 day cash gap between when vendors incur costs and when they receive payment. Legacy invoice lenders have little visibility into how to underwrite these assets.

Masterpiece closes that gap by advancing capital against high quality lab contracts and invoices. Vendors can use the capital to scale delivery, pay contributors, and fund growth, then repay masterpiece when the lab payment arrives.
one_liner: Working capital for data companies training frontier AI

You state the goal, Degla figures out how.

name: Collar
long_description:
We are a team of ex-intelligence, ex-finance, and most importantly, ex-founders who have known each other for over 5 years.

Collar is redefining investor relations. 

Right now, investor relations is an under-appreciated yet sweeping function. 
They have a bird’s eye view of what external stakeholders want, and also work with internal business units to create a grand vision of a company’s future.

But they’re doing it with their hands tied behind their back.

Finance AI tools today are built for investors not investor relations, leaving teams using ad-hoc unreliable workarounds, and CFOs are stuck always reporting rather than acting on insights to optimize operational workstreams.

Before earning calls, Collar prepares CFOs through proactive earnings calls prep, investor targeting and fully citation-backed live teleprompters, saving them hours of work.

After earning calls, CFOs use Collar’s trusted agentic AI systems to optimize identified underperforming workstreams with little manual modification needed. 

Redefining investor relations from a tedious cost centre headache, into a whole-of-company profit maximising function.

We call this Agent-Led Growth (~coding agents GEO for dev tools).

And once agents use your product, Armature shows you what users do with it through AI, with self-serve MCP analytics and evals that catch regressions before your users see them.
one_liner: We get your product picked by coding agents.

name: Pops
long_description:
Pops lets people play, remix, and share AI games with friends.

Discover an infinite feed of games, challenges, quizzes, and other fun interactive experiences made by others. Every play instantly becomes a funny gameplay/reaction video you can send to friends, post online, or use to challenge someone to beat your score.

For creators, Pops makes it easier than ever to bring ideas to life and get them played. Instead of learning complex game engines, writing code, or fighting for distribution, anyone can create or remix a playable game in seconds. Bring your ideas, and Pops brings the audience.
one_liner: Create & play AI games with friends

name: Tolmo
long_description:
Tolmo is an agent-driven security platform that secures every layer — code, CI, cloud applications at the speed of AI changes.

Codebases are growing faster than ever, at a rate humans can’t keep up with. Tolmo deploys fleets of AI security agents on a live production knowledge graph that connects data from cloud services, containers, databases, and third-party providers (Observability, Security, etc.).

Tolmo agents triage, verify impact, and remediate security issues autonomously, escalating to humans only when truly necessary.
one_liner: Tolmo is the AI security platform that secures every layer of cloud…

name: Rodeo Robotics
long_description:
Rodeo builds a robotic technician that automates maintenance so fleets can get vehicles back on the road sooner. Initial deployments focus on oil changes at centralized depots, where routine maintenance competes for scarce technician time.

Cofounders Michael Hazard and Colby Duke met at Applied Intuition, where they worked with OEMs like Toyota and General Motors to bring software and autonomy to vehicles. They saw firsthand how much manual work it takes to keep vehicle fleets running, and learned how to make autonomy reliable through structured testing, real-world data, and human intervention.

They’re now applying their experience to the roughly $600B annual US vehicle maintenance market. The average US vehicle is older than ever, driving up maintenance demand at a time when shops already struggle to hire and retain technicians. That gap leaves fleets facing costly downtime and preventable breakdowns.

Despite this need, vehicle maintenance has resisted traditional automation. Service information is fragmented and unreliable, and vehicle hardware varies significantly between makes and models. Rodeo builds on advances in robotic foundation models to learn maintenance skills that transfer across vehicles.

Rodeo pairs robots with human technicians who ensure each job is completed correctly, handling work the robots can’t yet perform autonomously. These deployments generate training data for Rodeo’s models through both teleoperation and hand tools augmented to record how technicians work. This lets Rodeo earn revenue while collecting the data needed to automate more of each job and improve margins.
one_liner: Robots for vehicle maintenance.

name: Probe
long_description:
Probe is building the agent-native research stack.

Our goal is simple: help AI/ML teams run better experiments, faster. We believe research will drive progress and everyone deserves to have their own personalized lab that iterates faster than ever before. 

Probe brings core research tools, shared context from past experiments, and visibility into each run together in one platform. Helping teams spend less time setting up infrastructure, supervising agents, catching teammates up and more time testing ideas.

Built for helping research labs experiment faster while keeping every researcher and agent aligned, and helping AI/ML teams setup a research capability without building a lab’s infrastructure first.
one_liner: The Agent-Native Research Stack

name: Enjamb Labs
long_description:
We've worked with 130 life science companies, preclinical through phase 3, to deploy AI securely inside the systems they already work in.

Pharma runs on decades of closed software like Benchling, Veeva, Medidata, and SAS. None of it has an AI layer or speaks MCP, so agents cannot reach the systems where the work lives.

Enjamb is that layer. Our agents run on top of existing systems and data, with no migration, and they reach the lab systems and internal tools no other AI touches. They learn how a team works, then do the work in Slack, in Teams, and in the systems themselves, across preclinical research, clinical evidence, trial design, statistical programming, and regulatory submissions.

This is AI tailored for how medicine gets made.
one_liner: The AI Workforce for Biopharma

name: rekursiv.ai
long_description:
We're scaling self-improving AI scientist teams to ideate/experiment/discover, generating new knowledge autonomously. Their discoveries reduced ARC-1/2 costs by 10,000× while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy and yielded material advances on combinatorial ML problems.

We believe that AI is bounded not by compute, but ideas. Scaling to millions of sessions of discovery enables leveraging its own discoveries and presents a novel training source capable of ushering a new era of self-reliant foundational models.
one_liner: Scale AI scientists whose own breakthroughs accelerate the next.

name: Amorphic Labs
long_description: The next billion software users are AI agents, yet agents still can't act on their own: every paid tool they need runs through a human making accounts, managing API keys, and guessing which provider is best. We are the capability marketplace built for agents: one MCP and one balance through which agents find, pay for, and use APIs, data, skills, other agents, and software at runtime, with every request routed to the best provider based on benchmarks from real tasks and outcome feedback from the agents themselves.
one_liner: OpenRouter for Agent Tools

name: Proprio Robotics
long_description: Proprio Robotics is building state-of-the-art physical intelligence to automate the entire data center lifecycle—from buildout to maintenance to decommissioning. There are currently 400,000 unstaffed data center technicians positions in the United States alone, which means the massive compute needs of AI are being bottlenecked by labor constraints. Proprio is solving this by building robots that do it instead, and is deploying data center maintenance robots starting Q1 2027.
one_liner: Robots to maintain and assemble data centers

name: Rindler
long_description:
We build Maxxwell, a desktop app for people who run several coding agents at once.

Past two or three sessions, you become the bottleneck. Every session asks you something, most of it small, and you spend the day answering instead of deciding. It is also hard to tell which sessions are making progress, which are stuck on something trivial, and which have quietly started building the wrong thing.

Maxxwell puts every session in one window and marks each one working, idle, or waiting on you. On top of that sits an orchestrator, a real coding-agent session of its own that reads the others and reports back. You talk to it instead of to twelve terminals. It tells you what landed, what it decided for you, and what actually needs your call.

Every worker is your own tool, unmodified. Claude Code, Codex and Cursor Agent run in real terminal sessions you can attach to and take over at any point
one_liner: The IDE for Tokenmaxxers

name: CONUS

CONUS structures fragmented medical device information for surgeons. We combine manufacturer documentation, hospital protocols and medical research in one place, giving surgeons and MedTech teams reliable answers across products and procedures.

We already work with leading manufacturers including Johnson & Johnson, Stryker and Zimmer Biomet, and since launching six months ago we’ve gone live in 20 hospitals.

Long term, hospitals will use CONUS to select and order implants across manufacturers.

name: Moonshot
long_description:
We want to bring AI agents to a billion people.

To do this, we believe it needs to be 1. proactive and 2. personal. A billion people already carry the right device, but none of them have the right connector.

Moonshot is personal intelligence that lives on your iPhone and listens to you 24/7. It continuously builds up a greater understanding of you through constantly listening and building context. It just pays deep attention, the way a good friend does. Through this, Moonshot monitors your conscious and subconscious life, figuring out what you need before you know, reminding you about open loops, identifying life and emotional trends before you recognize it, and covering a lot more of what we gloss over in daily life.

For fifty years, software has waited to be asked. We think tools are just good enough to flip this, and the next great software will provide value before asking for something first. We're doing it through Moonshot.

Our thesis is simple: you're only living half your life. The half that you actively remember. The other half just evaporates into your subconscious: what you said, felt, promised, and forgot. It's the more interesting half, and until now nothing could catch it, making it not actionable.

Moonshot catches your subconscious half and understands you well enough to take actions on your behalf.

Take life personally.

The iOS app is designed around ambient listening and clear user control. Short microphone chunks are sent securely to Moonshot's private transcription service and deleted when transcription finishes. Text and selected context can be sent through Moonshot's server to a model when the app needs to understand a moment. Nothing leaves without your yes. The privacy policy explains every data path, stored copy, permission, and deletion control in detail.

Moonshot is in early access. Join the waitlist to hear when access opens, read more about the team and product on the About page, or use the Contact page for a direct written response from the Moonshot team.

Let's make it a Moonshot.
one_liner: agents for the rest of us

name: Donkey
long_description:
Donkey is the AI-native trading company. Upload a buying list and we land the whole container at one locked, delivered price, tariffs included. You buy from Donkey: one contract, one company responsible for everything between the factory floor and your door. Our own people check the cartons before the factory gets paid, and the balance is due when the goods are accepted at your dock.

Small businesses buy imports through three or four middlemen, each adding 15 to 30 points, because none of them can fill a container on their own. Big enough to buy pallets, never big enough to buy the box. Quotes float with freight, FX and tariffs and live 15 to 30 days.

A trading company is rooms of people on the phone with factories, forwarders and brokers. Donkey runs that as one engine. It finds the real factory behind the customs record, stacks duty line by line, packs the container on weight and cube, and returns one number that holds from signature. Next comes the shared container: small buyers fill one box together at container prices, and every container earns better factory terms for the next one.

Team in San Francisco and Wuhan, English and Mandarin. If your business buys pallets of anything imported, send us your buying list.
one_liner: The AI-native trading company: factory prices, delivered, one number

NebuSec is founded by the world’s #1 hacking team.

We were the first team to build an nginx RCE and the first to root Android 17. Our co-founders include members of the world’s No. 1 CTF team, DEF CON winners, Black Hat speakers, and PhD in cybersecurity. We have won $400K in bug bounties by exploiting the Linux kernel and Chrome browser.

name: Rex
long_description:
Rex is a managed AI service for AR and order-to-cash. AI agents and finance experts run the work that delays payment, from collections, portals, disputes and remittances to the shared AR inbox, so cash keeps moving.

Order to cash is a $60B outsourced function because the work is too messy for traditional automation. Every customer has different context, exceptions do not follow clean rules, and the next step is often buried in emails, portals, handoffs, or someone’s memory. Rex agents run continuously in the background and resolve work to SLA standards so cash keeps moving. We're live with pre-IPO tech companies, managing  >$500m in receivables from F100 companies, cutting manual follow-up cycles from weeks to hours.

We founded Rex after spending four years building Sequence, an a16z-backed finance ops platform, from zero to Series A — where we saw firsthand that at-scale, O2C still runs on manual labour.

Rex is the #1 winner of the Vercel AI Accelerator out of 2,500 teams, selected by Guillermo Rauch and leaders from OpenAI, Anthropic, Browserbase and more.
