name: Ekho Labs
long_description: Ekho predicts the wars, strikes and tariffs that break global shipping, and tells freight teams which shipments are exposed and what to do about them. Predicting escalation is what our team did for eight years before this - now we bring the same engine to logistics.
one_liner: World Model for Freight

name: Isengard Industries Inc
long_description:
Isengard Industries is not another drone company.

We build sovereign production: the means for allied nations to make precision-strike and counter-drone systems by the thousand, on their own soil, at a fraction of what the primes charge.

We call it Weapons of Mass Production. The Arsenal of Democracy, rebuilt for the drone age.

More to come, and only where it helps. You know how to reach us.
one_liner: Mass-produced AI strike systems and Counter-UAS

name: Denta
long_description: We are helping patients receive better care at a lower cost by giving buying power to the individual.
one_liner: Fortune 500 Dental Benefits

name: Computable
one_liner: Derivatives Exchange for Compute

name: Financial Datasets
long_description:
Financial Datasets is an applied AI research lab building search and data infrastructure for agents, starting with financial markets.

We turn filings, company disclosures, and market data into structured, searchable information - helping agents find relevant facts, answer financial questions, and monitor markets in real time.

For 40 years, market data was built for people reading screens. We're rebuilding it for agents that research every company, all day, across the world.
one_liner: Connect your agents to the stock market

name: Liquid Energy
long_description:
Liquid Energy delivers the most scalable and cost effective inference. Our compute is hosted in our proprietary data center modules that we call NanoDC - the Nano Data Center. 

NanoDC is engineered to be rapidly deployable and scalable without traditional bottlenecks like power, permitting, and supply chains. Using NanoDC, Liquid Energy is able to provide the most efficient and sustainable way to scale compute to meet global AI demand.
one_liner: Self contained solar-powered AI inference modules: the NanoDC

name: Luca IQ
long_description: Luca IQ is an API for deterministic tax calculation and an IRS Authorized e-filing engine - the foundation for accounting firms and fintechs building on tax.
one_liner: API-first tax engine for CPA firms and developers

name: Pacific
long_description:
We mass-produce modular data centers that deploy on stalled infrastructure projects losing billions per week.

Delayed infrastructure projects hemorrhage $1B a week in the US alone - Pacific mass-produces modular data centers that deploy on those sites in days and turn their unused power into revenue.

Data centers are stuck for years waiting for power, while delayed construction sites across the world sit on unused interconnects, losing billions of dollars per week in interest on trillions of dollars of debt. Our pods deploy on those sites and generate revenue for them in days. They use diamond wafers in the cooling system so pods run anywhere on earth, even a desert. 

We'll use the same mechanisms we're building today to deploy compute across the galaxy.
one_liner: Mass-producing and financing micro data center incredibly quickly.

name: Last Accounting Company
long_description:
Last Accounting Company (LAC) is a full-stack AI accounting firm. We sell the same service (bookkeeping, tax filings, etc.) as a traditional accounting firm, but underneath agents handle everything and a certified accountant signs off. Our service is faster, cheaper, and fully integrated, allowing our clients to focus on what matters, not accounting admin.

LAC replaces both outsourced accountants and legacy accounting software for startups and SMBs. Our system is fully proprietary, from the general ledger to the accounting agents. This allows us to create powerful self-reinforcing loops and ultimately provide a state-of-the-art accounting service.
one_liner: AI-native accounting firm.

name: Executor
long_description:
Executor.sh is an MCP gateway that allows you to sign in once to all of your integrations and use them with any client.

We enable you to connect your agents to anything (MCP, GraphQL, OpenAPI) so regardless of what you're trying to connect agents to you're able to.

If you're trying to scale agents to access all of your production services, data, etc, you need Executor as a unified management layer.
one_liner: The open source tool gateway

name: Waybill
long_description:
Hardware teams burn weeks on procurement. An engineer needs a part. Someone emails five distributors, chases quotes, gets an approval, wires the money, tracks a shipment across three carriers, clears customs, and then nobody knows where the box is or what's actually on the shelf.

Waybill runs that entire loop. Send us a part, a spec, or a BOM. We source it, pull quotes, route approvals, pay the supplier, handle freight and customs, track it to your dock, and keep your stock count updated. 

Take your supply chain for granted.

Built by a team that's seen it at LAT Aerospace and WareIQ (YC S20).
one_liner: Agentic procurement & inventory for deep tech teams.

name: Marengo
long_description:
Marengo is the AI-native engineering firm automating engineering design, starting with data centers. We’ve generated $70K in revenue in our first month, with $4M in contracts to deliver.

Marengo is backed by YC, Exor, Future Planet Capital, undisclosed $2B AUM family office, and other top-tier investors.

Our team includes the former President & CEO of Saipem America ($3B+ P&L), former President of Exyte's Advanced Technology Facilities GBU ($6B+ P&L) and more.
one_liner: AI-Native Engineering Firm designing Data Centers

name: Lumeria
long_description: The Lumoscope is a multispectral camera that clips onto your phone and scans your skin at home with the same light used in clinics. You see what a mirror can't: a breakout days before it surfaces, and wrinkles changing over time. Our software then reads that history, connects flare-ups to causes you'd never suspect, and matches products to what your own data shows works.
one_liner: Oura Ring for Skin

name: Inkbox
long_description: For your AI agents to behave like teammates, we give them persistent identities with their own email, phone, and iMessage. We also provide them an agent-to-agent channel, so they can communicate for task delegation.
one_liner: The identity and communication layer for AI agents

name: Gamgee
long_description:
​Gamgee began with Rosie, founder Paul Conyngham’s dog. After surgery, chemotherapy and immunotherapy failed, Rosie was given months to live. Paul used AI and genomic analysis to identify targets in her tumour, then worked with scientists at UNSW to produce what is believed to be the first fully computationally designed mRNA cancer vaccine delivered to a dog. Following treatment, several tumours shrank significantly and her quality of life improved

Gamgee is building an end to end platform for personalised mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs. We sequence a dog’s tumour and healthy DNA, identify mutations unique to its cancer, and design a vaccine that teaches the immune system what to attack. We manage the entire process- from vet intake and tissue collection through genomic analysis, vaccine production, treatment and response monitoring

​We are now turning that one off effort into a repeatable clinical system. Gamgee is running clinical trials in Australia, working with vets, oncologists and specialised laboratories, and accepting cases globally. Our goal is to make personalised cancer treatment accessible to every dog that needs it- and use each case to improve the treatment for the next
one_liner: Curing cancer. Starting with dogs.

name: Agnost AI
long_description: Agnost AI reads every conversation a company's AI Agent has with its users to find where it's silently failing and then turns that same data into custom models that run the agent better, faster & cheaper than frontier models.
one_liner: We find where AI agents fail, then train better models to run them.

name: Care GP
long_description: Care GP is building AI agents to run operations for primary healthcare clinics
one_liner: AI agents to run primary healthcare operations

name: Axelrod
long_description: Autonomous software for hotels that takes over all front-of-house and back-of-house tasks with zero integrations, running operations better than your staff would. Axelrod is trusted by Michelin Key awarded and Marriott hotels and is live across 3 continents.
one_liner: Hotels that run themselves

name: CarSignal
long_description:
CarSignal is the AI-native operating system for independent auto repair shops.

Most shops still run each repair across disconnected management software, scan tools, parts catalogs, service information, texts, spreadsheets, and knowledge kept in technicians’ heads. That fragmentation slows diagnosis, creates duplicate processes, and leaves customers waiting.

CarSignal connects the full repair process in one system. AI agents research vehicle-specific failure patterns and surface the tests that confirm or rule out each cause. The same system carries each job from booking and intake through inspections, estimates, parts, approvals, payment, and follow-up, so technicians spend less time searching and updating systems and more time fixing cars.
one_liner: The AI Operating System for Auto Shops.

name: Decawork
long_description:
An agent’s access should depend on the task it is doing. The same action can be appropriate for one task and wrong for another. Access decisions need to adapt in real time as the agent works, but companies can’t turn every business judgment into a fixed rules or have people manually approve every step.

We train small, company-specific models that approve AI actions in real time. They consider the company’s policies and interests, the agent’s current task, and its past actions to decide whether each proposed action should be allowed. Access is specific to the task at hand and reassessed as the agent works.

Companies will rent intelligence from AI labs or run open-source models to power their agents. They’ll own the models that keep their entire AI workforce acting in their interests. Decawork is building those models.
one_liner: Training company-specific models that approve AI actions.

name: Pennant
long_description: Led by former institutional proxy voters and technologists with a collective 20+ years of experience, Pennant gives institutional investors, public companies, and corporate advisors voting and governance intelligence to act on their own principles at scale.
one_liner: The World Model for Corporate Governance

name: Tokenless
long_description:
Tokenless is an applied AI research lab. Our goal is to end reward hacking. We do research and build tools to detect issues with environments and evals, understand model behavior in those environments, and prevent those issues from happening. Correcting them makes training more effective, makes model performance easier to interpret, and is crucial to solving the AI alignment problem.

If you’re training models with RL, building environments, or running agent evals, and want more confidence in your environments, we're here to help.
one_liner: We find flaws in RL environments and evals and help you fix them.

name: Mireye
long_description:
AI agents are starting to act in the real world, but they can't reliably understand it. 

Every fact about a place has its own silo: land in GIS maps, power in utility portals, people in census tables, policy in county PDFs. All built for humans, none for agents. Underneath, the data is fragmented across thousands of sources, unstructured and complex.

Mireye is building the infrastructure that powers agents to make decisions and act in the real world. One API and MCP to connect agents to the physical world with accurate data enrichment, signals and tools.

Our mission is to index every inch of the earth, and make it as queryable as the web.
one_liner: Search Engine for the Physical World

name: Lamb Labs
long_description: Lamb Labs is building Model Processing Units (MPUs), custom AI chips that hardcode LLM weights directly into silicon. Rather than adapting general-purpose processors to run AI models, we're rethinking how LLMs are implemented in hardware to make inference dramatically faster and more energy-efficient.
one_liner: Lightning fast chips with hardcoded AI models

name: 83 Sciences
long_description: 83 Sciences uses AI to mine discarded experimental data and drive scientific breakthroughs. Working alongside labs, we discover the materials that will power the new Industrial Revolution.
one_liner: AI-native materials discovery powered by unpublished experimental data

name: Palisade
one_liner: AI that finds and fixes OS-level vulnerabilities across device fleets

name: Skymerse
long_description: Skymerse is building one AI system for airline flight operations: from planning and monitoring in the operations center to real-time support in the cockpit. It is developing specialized aeronautical models that understand the data, constraints, and procedures behind each flight, replacing fragmented tools and manual interpretation. Notamify, its first product, already serves airline customers and thousands pilots and aviation professionals.
one_liner: Autopilot for Flight Operations

name: HyperProbe
long_description:
With tools like Cursor and Claude Code, writing software is no longer the bottleneck. Debugging is. Agents cannot fix production crashes using logs and traces that were sized for human eyeballs. The gap is missing data.

HyperProbe allows agents to debug live software autonomously. Our SDK drops non-breaking probes straight into running services to read exact variable states from memory at the moment of failure, instead of reasoning backwards from flat logs.

Zero redeploys. Under 1% CPU overhead. Automatic PII redaction.

We turn 4-hour production war rooms into 10-minute automated resolutions. As agents write and operate more of the world's software, HyperProbe is the runtime observability layer that lets them understand what they built.
one_liner: AI engineer that debugs and fixes production incidents in realtime

name: TovenAI
long_description:
TovenAI builds a platform of AI agents that handle manual, data-intensive work for compliance teams at institutional trading firms, with six agents currently live. Our customers range from specialist firms to large global institutions, with our agents supporting multiple compliance workflows at a top-10 institutional brokerage.

With prebuilt connectors to more than 30 systems—including Bloomberg, Cloud9, and NICE Actimize—firms can onboard to our platform and evaluate results using their own data in less than a week.
one_liner: AI agents for compliance at institutional trading firms

name: Verdict Machine
all_locations: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
long_description:
Verdict Machine uses AI to understand each financial institution's complete on-chain environment, assess its cyber risk and generate tailored controls. The same live model powers transaction prevention, continuous cyber diligence, security posture and cost-efficient wallet screening. Before execution, Verdict Machine evaluates proposed transactions against the institution's active policies.

In our first weeks, we started POCs with asset managers and digital-asset infrastructure providers whose systems move billions of dollars every week for financial institutions. We're now in active evaluations with digital-asset teams at some of the world's largest banks.

The founding team launched and led blockchain security at Check Point (NASDAQ: CHKP).
one_liner: AI cybersecurity for financial institutions' digital assets

name: Dock
long_description: Dock is where you hire AI agents for business. Bring an idea, and your agents turn it into a company that runs: they find the customers, do the work and keep it moving, day and night. Building a company used to mean hiring a building full of people first. With Dock, entrepreneurs can start a real business today and run it like a company of a hundred. You decide where it goes. Your agents make it happen.
one_liner: AI agents that run your business.

name: OpenRelay
one_liner: Distributed, hardware-agnostic AI inference

name: isoquant
one_liner: Self-optimizing inference cloud for faster, cheaper AI

name: PRINCEPS
long_description: PRINCEPS is the first purpose-built insurance company for the trillion-dollar compute buildout. We underwrite SLA, GPU residual value, and outage risk, and price the coverage that unlocks cheaper financing for data centers and neoclouds.
one_liner: AI-native insurance company for the compute economy

name: Hebbian Robotics
long_description: Hebbian Robotics builds open source foundational infrastructure for Physical AI to develop robots that extend what humanity can do, for the benefit of the communities they serve.
one_liner: Foundational infrastructure for Physical AI

name: Florin
long_description: Florin is a full-stack insurance carrier where a model does the underwriting. When a submission comes in, Florin reads the ACORD forms, then investigates the risk on its own: satellite imagery, permits, public records, even the insured's Instagram, and catches exposures that never make it onto the application. It then simulates tens of thousands of ways the policy year could go, prices the risk, and returns a bindable quote in under a minute instead of weeks. The team is ex-Google, Tesla, Amazon, and Terrafirma, and the bet is that a carrier built this way wins on loss ratio, speed, and cost at the same time.
one_liner: Florin is an AI-native insurance company that runs autonomously

name: Locke
long_description:
Locke is the AI-native firm for public influence. 

We pair elite lobbyists and political talent with our own AI systems, helping companies lobby policymakers and win government contracts.

Locke's team comes from The White House, Congress, and the Pentagon.
one_liner: The AI-native firm for public influence.

name: Petrarch
long_description: Petrarch works with bankruptcy courts to source records from enterprises in the critical infrastructure sectors, then rigorously de-identifies and transforms the data into RL environments and tasks.
one_liner: Advancing model capabilities for critical infrastructure

name: Tracer
long_description:
Tracer is an AI research lab building more capable and efficient AI through model coordination. We research adaptive inference, ensembling, and systems in which multiple open-source models work together to produce capabilities beyond any single model.

Our work spans reasoning, code, research, and agentic systems, with the goal of making advanced intelligence more accessible and economical.
one_liner: Combining open-source AI models for better answers at lower cost

name: Wondering
long_description:
Wondering turns anything you want to learn, from LLMs to quantum mechanics to product design, into a path of three-minute lessons with visuals, podcasts, and interactive exercises. 

Each learning path and its content are personalized to your background, how you learn best, and how deep you want to go.

It’s the most delightful way to understand complex topics and turn information into knowledge you can remember and apply. You don’t just passively read. You practice, make connections, and form your own insights.

Start learning anything for free at https://wondering.app/download
one_liner: Duolingo for learning anything

name: OneCLI
long_description:
OneCLI (YC S26) is an open-source platform for delegating business-critical work to AI agents, from Salesforce updates to data analysis and engineering investigations.

Agents work across your company’s apps, prepare changes, and pause for approval when your rules require it. Your team controls what they can access and change, while credentials stay out of the agents’ reach and every call is logged.

https://www.onecli.sh
one_liner: AI teammates for your business-critical work.

name: Dawn Industries
long_description: VIM connects to the entire cell: PLCs, robots, CNC machines, sensors. When a cell faults, VIM finds the cause, stages the fix, and the operator approves with one click. When a part drifts, VIM catches it seconds after the cut, inside the machine, and recommends the correction. Recovery drops from 30 minutes to under two, saving more than $15,000 per fault in large factories.
one_liner: Automatic Diagnosis & Fix for Industrial Automation Cells

name: Autoresearch, Inc.
long_description:
Autoresearch helps teams train agents for tasks where general models are not good enough. Give us a task, your current agent or model, and an evaluation. Autoresearch runs an autoresearch campaign across data, SFT and other post-training methods, continual learning, prompts, tools, harnesses, and systems, then returns the best verified improvement. It runs hosted or in your cloud.

We provide the research system around models: persistent memory, full experiment lineage, compute orchestration, and statistical verification. We’re starting with agent and model training, continual learning, and optimization.

Reach out to us for early access at founders@autoresearch.inc.
one_liner: Autoresearch as a service: we solve your hardest measurable problems

name: Robocurve
long_description:
Robocurve builds open-source tools and independent benchmarks to measure how well robots can do real-world jobs. Instead of relying on unverified demo videos from frontier labs, we score their models on reproducible benchmarks that anyone can trust.

Today there are no well-run, standardized robotics benchmarks. Labs evaluate in-house, and no independent group has stepped in to run continuous benchmarking as a service. The result is that no one actually knows how good anyone else is, or where the real frontier sits.

Good benchmarks require operating and maintaining physical hardware and real-world setups. Simulation only goes so far, since models that look strong in sim can show large performance gaps once deployed in the real world. Building real-world benchmarks means coordinating job-domain experts, evals engineering, and hands-on robotics all at once.

Frontier labs are targeting general-purpose robotics by 2028, yet the field of robotics evals barely exists. Whoever builds the trusted measure of robot capability becomes the reference everyone relies on. We combine backgrounds in AI evals and robotics to build and grow this field as fast as possible. We already shipped v1 of our open-source framework, Inspect Robots, and ran our first pilot scoring a frontier model on a real robot.
one_liner: Evals for robots

name: Allia Health
long_description: Allia is the first full-stack, AI-native clinical group for mental health. We bring independent practices into one national clinical group that can deliver, measure, and improve care at scale .
one_liner: AI-Native Medical Group for Mental Health

name: Osseus
long_description: In an era of cheap intelligence, the most important application of AI will be to improving human health, globally. Osseus is building the frontier biomedical AI research lab, starting with the clinical datasets, evaluations, and reinforcement learning environments that help AI labs train more capable, aligned, and safe models.
one_liner: The frontier data platform for aligned health and biological AI

name: hardware intelligence
long_description: Hardware Intelligence makes chip design tools that cut simulation and debugging time by an order of magnitude. When a chip test fails, engineers need a recording of every internal signal - a waveform. We’ve developed WaveZip, which captures waveforms 500x smaller with 200x less overhead, and Wave, which beats frontier models on industry chip debugging benchmarks. We’re Rishov Sarkar (Georgia Tech Ph.D. in chip simulation) and Athreya Anand (ex-Google, M.S. ML/AI), YC S26. https://hardwareintelligence.ai
one_liner: AI tools for the chips your AI runs on

name: Billow AI Labs
long_description:
Billow handles the work of Accounting and FP&A FTEs keeping teams compliant and audit-ready. We work within existing stacks (NetSuite, Coupa, and 80+ other systems) and complex spreadsheets, chasing down information and coordinating approvals across stakeholders. 

Built by repeat founders; Joan built and exited an accounting/ERP platform (45,000 businesses in 4 years) and Phil built Bloomberg's financial “brain” data infrastructure, and as CTO of a trading platform ($1B in volume). Advisors include CFOs, controllers, auditors from publicly-traded biopharma, and a Big-4 Accounting firm.
one_liner: AI-native Accounting Firm that's killing Deloitte

name: Magma
long_description: We enable companies monetize their agents' traces.
one_liner: Monetize your agent's traces.

name: Grep AI
long_description:
Grep AI is the fastest way to create, optimize, and deploy agents for tedious, complex operational work that slows down your business. Our self-improving agents learn from every run, making them smarter and cheaper as you scale. IG.com a global retail brokerage used our agents to review compliance alerts and now 80% of their customers onboad without manual intervention, doubling first trades and propelling them to a FTSE 100 company. 

Customers including Airwallex, Worldpay, Citizens Bank, FV Bank and Shopmonkey have used our agents to automate over 250,000 of operational work across compliance, onboarding, underwriting, corporate due diligence, document verification, merchant categorization, market and competitive research, rev ops and much more.

We founded Grep AI after experiencing firsthand how manual workflows can prevent a business from growing when we ran the platform team at Brex. We're now on a mission to rid businesses of tedious, repetitive so their employees can focus on the most high leverage tasks that matter.
one_liner: Self-improving agents that automate your growth bottlenecks

name: UFO.ai
long_description:
UFO is the operating platform for your business built by the creators of Github Copilot and Perplexity Computer. 

UFO learns your company, goals, tools, and workflows. UFO builds what your team needs to keep work moving.
one_liner: Next-generation agent operating system

name: CoArena
long_description: CoArena is a live arena where anyone can use the world's top computer-use models racing two of them on the same real computer task and judging which one did it better. Every battle becomes something the AI labs can't build themselves, an honest test of their agents on real work, and the data to make them better.
one_liner: The biggest crowdsourced benchmark for Computer-Use

name: Experiential Labs
long_description: We are building an open source gateway for AI budget holders to control model access and turn their traffic into better models that they own. We're a team that has earned an ML PhD at Georgia Tech, scaled AutoGPT to 160k GitHub stars, and led a self-driving simulation team at Waabi.
one_liner: Open source AI gateway that turns your traffic into better models

name: Simantic
long_description: Simantic is modernizing the embedded firmware industry with hardware simulation developed for the adoption of AI in hardware engineering. Simantic gives both humans and AI the visibility into hardware previously limited by the physical world.
one_liner: Firmware simulation for AI agents

name: Conifer
long_description: There are thousands of models, providers, and harnesses, each with its own pricing and strengths, leaving an overwhelming number of choices when it comes to managing token spend and intelligence. Conifer uses intelligent routing and orchestration logic to handle the full path of each query: model selection, provider choice, and cache management. It all runs inside your existing harness, so tools like Claude Code and Codex work without changing your setup. By centralizing where inference occurs, Conifer lets companies save on their inference bill while leaving teams free to focus on what they are building.
one_liner: Least cost routing system to reduce 70%+ token spend

name: OpenTag
long_description: OpenTag is an AI coworker in your Slack with full context on your company. It answers questions and takes real work off your plate. It also keeps your wiki up to date automatically, so knowledge never goes stale.
one_liner: Model Agnostic AI coworker in Slack

name: Runtime.si
long_description: Runtime is building the evaluation layer for physical intelligence. We push robot policies to their limits across thousands of simulated worlds, before they face the real one.
one_liner: Evaluation Infrastructure for Robotics (YC F26)

name: Hue
long_description: Hue turns production usage of agents into repeatable tests that preserve the tools, data, and state behind the real run. As AI agents take on real work, their behavior depends increasingly on the nuances of the world around them. With Hue, teams can test and improve their agents under conditions that mimic real usage.
one_liner: Test agents in realistic worlds built from production usage

name: herdr
long_description:
Developers don't run one coding agent anymore. They run fleets of them — for hours, sometimes days — across laptops, servers, and sandboxes. Keeping track of that work is the new bottleneck: which agent is blocked, which one finished, which terminal is it in, and why did everything die when the laptop closed.

Herdr is the open-source home for that work. A background server owns the agents' terminal sessions on each machine, so the work survives disconnects, closed lids, and dropped SSH. Herdr detects each agent and turns the chaos into an attention queue — working, blocked, done, across every project — so you look only when an agent needs you. Every client is just a view: the bundled terminal UI, SSH from another machine, your phone. Close one, open another; the work never stops.

Software can drive it too: a CLI, a socket API, and a plugin marketplace that passed 500 community plugins in its first month. The runtime is Apache-2.0 and stays open. Four months after launch: 25k GitHub stars, 340k downloads.
one_liner: building the open agent runtime

name: Theo
long_description: Theo is an AI agent that builds your small business website in minutes, then works on it every week so customers find you, whether they search Google themselves or ask an AI. Theo studies your site, your market and your search data, picks what will win the next customer, and ships it: a page for what people are searching for, a post that answers their question, or the fix that was holding you back.
one_liner: The site-builder and engine that gets your business found.

name: Sentient OS
long_description:
Truly personal AI requires running inference on your life, every day. In the cloud, that’s expensive and a privacy nightmare. On your own chip, it’s free and private.

Our custom inference stack, built on a LiteRT-LM fork, runs on Macs with just 8 GB of RAM. Every night, Sentient’s on-device models process your emails, messages, Granola transcripts, files, and more, building a rich personal knowledge base on your Mac.

Your projects, conversations, commitments, and preferences. Context you’d never have the time to type into a chatbot.

That understanding powers three ways to get work done:

Sidekick: click your Mac’s notch and say “finish this for me.” It already has your context and gets to work across your apps and browser with its own cursor, while you keep working.

Proactive intelligence: wake up to work already prepared. The reply you forgot, drafted. The subscription renewing tomorrow, caught. The report you promised, ready for review. Sentient waits for your approval before acting.

Double Tap: two taps, two seconds, and the reply you would have written appears, drafted from your personal context and writing style. Just review and send.

Open source and built with privacy at its core. Over 30 enterprises use Sentient already.

Our alpha reached 4,000+ users in its first week with $0 marketing. Our launch was the top post of the month on r/macapps.

We’ve raised over $1 million with participation from Y Combinator (F26), Afore, Pioneer Fund, and a16z speedrun’s scout fund.
one_liner: On-device AI that knows your entire life and does your work overnight.

name: Simulithic
long_description: AI made writing code fast. Testing it is still slow. Simulithic sends AI users through your app on every device, browser and account type your customers use, so you can ship as fast as you can code, without writing or maintaining a single test.
one_liner: AI users that test your app on every device and browser

name: Veeza AI
long_description: Billions of people need tourist visas to travel the world. We use AI agents to prepare applications, verify documents, secure appointments, and handle the visa process end to end.
one_liner: AI tourist visa agent for people with weak passports.

name: Petrichor
long_description: Real biology requires a wet lab, and building one takes years and a team most AI companies don't have. Petrichor runs their experiments at scale and sends back the dense, clean data their models need to learn from.
one_liner: Wet lab infrastructure that turns AI experiments into training data.

name: Topos
long_description: Topos is a neolab founded by two Harvard math dropouts, building agent swarms to bring the rigor and verifiability of mathematics to other fields. Starting in biology, we’re optimizing how agents communicate, formalize problems, and verify each other’s reasoning.
one_liner: Agent swarms for formal verification

name: Agent 37
long_description:
* Ready to Use Instantly: Skip the complex server setup. It comes pre loaded with top AI Agents (like Claude Code and Hermes) so your agents can start working immediately.

* Keep Your Work Safe: Unlike other systems that delete everything when they finish a task, these sandboxes remember your files, code, and settings forever until you delete them.

* Pay Only for What You Use: Stop paying for idle servers. You pay a tiny fee to store your files, but you only pay for compute power during the exact minutes your AI is actively running.

* Zero Infrastructure Headaches: You don’t need to be a senior DevOps engineer or manage complex cloud networks. One simple command handles the entire backend for you.

* Connect to Any App: Allow your AI agents to securely log into and interact with everyday tools like Slack, Gmail, and GitHub in just a few clicks.
one_liner: Cloud Sandbox for Agents

name: OpenScaffold
long_description:
OpenScaffold is building AGI for every deployment team.

The result is a custom scaffold that is autonomously harnessed for each deployment, drawn from customer discovery, business objectives, past deployments, and more.
one_liner: Superagent for Deployment Teams

name: Faraday
long_description:
Faraday builds industrial AI that learns how enterprises operate and executes long-horizon, multi-step tasks from the back office to the shop floor.

We sit on top of fragmented systems of record, coordinating work across existing software and teams. We combine operating procedures, enterprise data, and expert feedback to capture the rules and judgment behind complex processes. In customer-specific RL environments, we optimize the agent harness around each company’s systems, constraints, approvals, and exceptions.

We’re connecting to industrial hardware to bring live production data into the same feedback loop. Human corrections, machine data, and operating results help improve how agents plan and execute future work.
one_liner: Agents running manufacturers from the back office to the shop floor

name: Viraj Aero
long_description:
Viraj Aero builds gas turbines that deliver both power and cooling water for data centers. It needs no grid connection and no water pipeline.

Burning natural gas already produces water. Our patented system captures that water from the exhaust. Part of it cools the data center. The rest is turned into steam and injected back into the turbine. That gives up to 40% more power from the same fuel (cheaper compute) and cuts NOx emissions by up to 99%, which cuts permit approvals from years to weeks.

We're building a genset around our first-of-its-kind gas turbine. It fits in a 10-foot container and runs anywhere, even in the desert. That matters because two-thirds of new data centers are being built in water-stressed regions.

We first built this steam-injected turbine for aircraft, where carrying water tanks isn't an option and efficiency is critical. We're currently integrating our full-scale prototype into an aircraft. The team comes from GE, Rolls-Royce and Formula 1, and we're already working with Safran, one of the world's largest aircraft engine manufacturers.
one_liner: Next generation gas turbines for data centers & aviation

name: Orgo
long_description: Orgo is the simplest way to give your AI employees their own secure, persistent cloud computers. Over 1000 teams use Orgo to run AI workers.
one_liner: Computers for Agents

name: Applied Kinetics
long_description: Applied Kinetics is an AI-native, end-to-end manufacturer for data center and energy developers. We supply the transformers, switchgear, generators, cooling systems, and other critical equipment needed to bring new power and compute capacity online. Every unit is built to project specifications, and we manage the process from technical requirements through production and delivery. We shorten lead times and accelerate projects forward, removing the physical bottlenecks holding back the next generation of technological progress.
one_liner: AI-native manufacturing for data center and energy projects

name: Forward
long_description: An AI platform that connects commercial debt advisors with mandate matching private credit funds.
one_liner: Unifying Global Private Credit

name: Stacktrace
long_description:
Agents will do most of the work in the future, but only if teams can trust them unsupervised.
Stacktrace is the control layer for every agent: it sees every action, detects risky behavior, enforces the bounds your team sets, and steps in when an agent drifts from intent.
one_liner: See and control what your agents actually do

name: Altair Health
long_description:
Altair is an AI-native medical billing service for independent practices. We take over a practice's billing end to end and get doctors paid by insurers. AI does the work; our billers handle the exceptions.

That can only work if a practice can trust an agent alone with its revenue. So we formalized insurers' billing policies and put a theorem prover under the agent. Before the agent acts on a claim, the prover checks the action against that insurer's policies, and anything that fails goes to one of our billers. 

Every claim teaches Altair how each insurer behaves, so the longer we run a practice's billing, the better we predict what its insurers will pay, deny or delay.

We're building the default way a new practice gets paid: a doctor connects their EHR and bills clean, completely self-serve and on auto-pilot.

Altair will be the financial platform every independent practice in America starts on and stays on. And to the Health Insurers' "Delay, Deny, Defend", we say "Predict, Prevent, Prevail".
one_liner: Stripe for medical billing

name: Armorer Labs
long_description:
Armorer helps companies in regulated industries ship their own AI agents faster and keep them secure in production.

Most security tools flag an issue and file a ticket. Armorer assesses your agent and simulates attacks to find the real issues. Then it creates a verified fix that stops the attack without breaking the business, ready for your approval in about 4 hours.

In production, Armorer checks every agent action in milliseconds, with no GPU needed. It detects malicious behavior such as prompt injection, goal hijacking and data leaks, then allows, holds or denies the action.

Armorer's detection models beat every other detector we tested on six public benchmarks. Armorer is 22% more accurate than JEV while being 88x faster, so users won't feel the delay.

We spent years building and evaluating AI security systems together at AWS, including its first customer-facing AI security agent, which scaled to 100k+ customers. Armorer is backed by Paul Vixie, an internet pioneer inducted into the Internet Hall of Fame in 2014.
one_liner: Continuous security verification for AI agents in regulated industries

name: Talos
long_description: At Talos, we are building better, more modern predictive maintenance for the power industry with a focus on large transformers. Our devices continuously monitor critical power equipment and detect problems early on using anomaly-detection models. For each fault, we provide detailed analyses of the problem, exactly where and why it happened, as well as next steps teams should take.
one_liner: Predictive maintenance for power infrastructure.

name: Lantern AI
long_description:
Lantern is the agentic recruiting platform for enterprise. Traction: 1M ARR in 11 months, with clients like Crypto.com, Hyatt Hotel, Baker McKenzie across 10 markets

Lantern runs on: 
(1) World People Model, a live talent graph of a billion professionals that knows who’s exceptional, reachable, and about to move
(2) Company Hiring Model, which learns your taste from every hiring decision you’ve ever made

Together, our agents plug into your existing systems and run the whole workflow: sourcing, application review, AI interviews, meeting intelligence, and analytics, under universal context. 

After crossing $1M ARR, Lantern launched OpenRouter for People (people.lantern.md), an agent-native infrastructure to empower agents to find, research, outreach to anyone in the world.
one_liner: Turn Your Taste Into Hires

name: Munito AI
long_description:
Munito is an open-model inference provider for Europe, private by default. Its API lets users choose their models and keep inference and storage in the EU. 
Founded by the former inference lead at Mistral AI, Munito is built on one belief: open and independent intelligence, both models and inference, is key to economic growth and prosperity.
one_liner: Open-model inference provider for Europe, private by default.

name: Mirrors
long_description:
Production agents handle many different customer workflows. Currently, when one handles a situation badly, an engineer reads the trace and patches the prompt. The next situation needs another exception. Soon, improving the agent becomes a recurring engineering job, and the prompt keeps growing.

Mirrors finds patterns in past runs. Engineers review guidance for a specific situation and preview where it would apply. Mirrors then delivers that guidance while the agent works, inside the team’s existing setup. The team can check whether the change improved the outcome.

We’re building Mirrors for engineering teams running customer-facing agents across varied workflows, so they can improve behavior without hardcoding every lesson in the global prompt.
one_liner: Give AI agents the right context at the right moment

name: OpenCrawl
long_description:
OpenCrawl lets agents search over hard-to-find multimodal data.
Agents describe the data they need; OpenCrawl finds the sources, then builds and hosts custom crawlers, processing and search indexes. Each index is tuned to be the fastest, most accurate search over that data. Developers wire it into their products through MCP, CLI or API. Teams use it to find answers across their own files, tools and legacy systems.
one_liner: Search infrastructure, built for your agents.

name: Bryel
one_liner: Building the next generation of visual perceptual intelligence

name: River
long_description: AI made software engineers 100x more productive. We're doing the same thing for knowledge work with the AI computer.
one_liner: The AI computer.

name: Hopper
long_description: Hopper trains open-weight models on your production traces, then serves and improves them against your live traffic.
one_liner: Inference and post-training for realtime agents

name: ByteAsk
long_description: ByteAsk is an AI coding agent built for C and C++, the code that runs trading systems, cars, chips, and operating systems. It does not stop at a diff that looks right. ByteAsk builds, debugs, and tests every change with the real toolchain until the change holds. If the compiler, the debugger, or the tests can catch it, then ByteAsk catches it too. It runs from the terminal or inside VS Code, Neovim, and Emacs, and is available fully on-prem.
one_liner: The AI coding agent for C and C++

name: Agent Relay
long_description:
Agent Relay lets software teams' AI coding agents message each other directly, so people stop copy/pasting between Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and their teammates' agents. A frontend agent can ask the backend agent what an API returns, two agents can sort out a merge conflict between themselves, and your agent can answer a colleague's agent while you sleep.
 
Agents connect wherever they run: terminals, desktop apps, phones, laptops, cloud boxes, or a Mac mini across the world. Every session goes into shared, searchable history, so decisions don't get stuck in one person's chat. You can even let a customer's agent debug with yours. Setup takes about 5 minutes: give your agent the link and it installs itself. Use our hosted version free, or self-host the open-source version
one_liner: Let your teams' coding agents message each other

name: Invertix
long_description:
The next constraint is not intelligence, it is the energy and operational cost of running it.
We deploy custom AI models inside critical infrastructure companies that ingest SCADA data, work orders, human interventions,  operational data no public model has seen, grounded in physics-informed neural networks and differentiable simulators. 
This creates a flywheel: more operator data → better process understanding → more efficient operations → cheaper energy → cheaper AI → more deployment → more data. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0uDH6pMn5OE

AI compute doubles every 2.2 years. Data center demand grows from 415 to 945 TWh by 2030. Without near-zero energy cost, AI remains limited by human infrastructure. We are the layer that runs AI at zero energy cost.
Energy is a $10 trillion market. The infrastructure layer doesn't exist yet. 
We are building it.
one_liner: Energy Superintelligence, AI that operates critical infrastructure

name: sintem
long_description: Most phones are built to keep you on them. We make an agentic phone that puts an army of agents to work for you. Tell it what you need done, and they handle it across the tools and apps you already use. You get more work done with less time on your screen.
one_liner: An agentic phone that does your busywork

name: Dydema
long_description: We’re building a brain-computer interface anyone can wear, so you can use a computer at the speed of thought. To get there, we’re recording brain data at model company scale.
one_liner: A consumer brain-computer interface you can map to anything.

name: Plek
one_liner: Maps what employees do and what it costs

name: Workers IO
long_description:
Workers IO is building simulation environments to catch failures in mission-critical software before they reach production. We run your entire system through millions of simulated production scenarios to verify its correctness and performance properties.

Coding agents can now generate code faster than teams can review it. Meanwhile, software and the infrastructure it runs on keep getting more complex. Tests check a small set of cases in isolation, in environments that are different from production. Some of the most expensive failures only surface when customers encounter them.

We run your entire system unmodified and simulate network faults, disk failures, crashes, and clock drift. We build the fault models for you and check your system’s requirements across millions of scenarios. Every failure we find can be perfectly reproduced.
one_liner: Simulation environments for verifying mission-critical software

name: Quivly AI
long_description: Quivly is the agentic workspace for everything after the sale. Our agents turn kickoff calls into launch plans, chase blockers, catch risk and expansion signals, and have the full account story ready at renewal. With Quivly, companies are able to take their customers live in 7 days instead of 30, and then grow revenue from these customers by 4.3x on avg.
one_liner: AI agents that run onboarding, adoption, and renewals

name: Praxis
long_description:
At Praxis, we’ve built AI agents that run law firm operations, from first inquiry to paid invoice. Agents do the admin end to end, and the lawyer supervises and approves every step. Firms reply in minutes, onboard clients in days instead of weeks, and spend their time practicing law.

Lawyers spend 62% of their day on admin nobody pays for: intake, conflict checks, chasing documents, engagement letters, follow-ups, billing. Every hour on admin is an hour a client waits, and clients go to the firm that answers first. One law firm owner shared: “Every month we lose 3-5 clients, $10k each, because we’re 3 paralegals to handle the process, it’s too slow.”

We’re live with law firms across the US.
one_liner: AI agents that run law firm operations.

name: Shepherd Robotics
long_description: Shepherd Robotics builds general purpose robots for skilled physical work across AI infrastructure and advanced manufacturing. Our robots are powered by robot foundation models and use modular, flexible hardware designed to adapt to different environments and tasks. We train our systems on a combination of real world and simulation data so they can learn complex manipulation skills and generalize across workflows. We also provide integration into customers’ existing workflows, starting with data center construction and operations, electrical manufacturing and testing, and electronics manufacturing, where traditional automation struggles with variability, dexterity, and changing environments.
one_liner: Robots for high skilled labor powering AI infrastructure

name: ORO AI
long_description:
We're building the open benchmark for commerce.

Builders submit shopping agents. Independent validators run them against problems that change daily. The best agent earns the rewards, and every run becomes training data.
one_liner: Continuously improving evals for agentic commerce

name: Ploid
long_description:
Ploid is the AI-native people data infrastructure for developers and companies building products, workflows, and agents around people.

We've built an index of 2B+ people across professional and social sources, giving developers one API to search for people, enrich profiles, find emails and phone numbers, resolve identities, and retrieve up-to-date information from across the web. Unlike traditional people databases built around static records, Ploid combines its massive people index with real-time retrieval and identity resolution, delivering fresh, reliable information whenever it's needed. From sales and recruiting to customer intelligence, trust and safety, and AI agents, Ploid replaces fragmented data providers with a single infrastructure layer.

2B+ people. One API. Built for AI.
one_liner: The people data company for the agent era

name: Primordiant
long_description: Every instance of intelligence occurring in nature is embodied. Scientific intelligence is no different. We are building general-purpose robotic experimentalists: systems that unite scientific reasoning and physical action to iterate toward discovery by observing, hypothesizing and experimenting.
one_liner: Embodied Scientific Intelligence

name: Rystic
one_liner: Train models and test agents in high-fidelity simulated environments

name: Vorelios
long_description: We're building AI that understands the physical world well enough to do autonomous end-to-end engineering.
one_liner: Solving engineering, then using it to solve everything else

name: Dreamscale Labs
long_description: Dreamscale Labs is building the fastest cloud inference platform for robotics. As complex physical AI models become difficult to fit on expensive on-robot GPUs, we let users offload inference to the cloud and serve them with real-time latency. So far, we've hit 40-50% lower latency than existing neoclouds.
one_liner: Real-time cloud inference for robotics.

name: Resin Technologies
long_description:
Resin is an AI-native ECAD tool. It lets engineers:
- research designs
- generate schematics
- generate any symbols/footprints
- route simple to complex boards
one_liner: Resin helps engineers design electronics faster and more reliably

name: Telamont
long_description:
Telamont catches contractual, technical and code-compliance risks in construction documents and gives teams the system to act on them before they become costly rework or disputes.

Construction projects lose money in the gap between what the documents say and what gets built. One missed discrepancy between the specs, drawings, geotechnical study and code can become a seven-figure claim eighteen months later.

Telamont connects to where your documents live and pulls in every file and revision as it lands, continuously building a complete picture of the project. Every page is checked against the rest of the project, so risks are flagged as soon as they appear. Instead of reviewing documents, teams act on flagged risks, tracking each from detection to resolution while managing exposure and pursuing recovery opportunities across every project.
one_liner: Sentry for risks in construction documents

name: Ignition Benefits
long_description: Ignition is an AI-native employee benefits brokerage for companies with under 200 employees. Health insurance is one of the largest line items these companies carry, and employers absorb 15 to 40% rate increases year after year without ever seeing their own numbers. We have rebuilt the sales and back office to be AI-first. This market represents about $500B of market cap, and those businesses have not fundamentally changed in over 50 years. While scaling Plated, I wore every HR hat from doing payroll myself, to managing a PEO, to eventually hiring an employee benefits broker on our way to 1,500 employees. We wasted over $4M on benefits over 5 years, and I'm building Ignition to help companies under 200 employees avoid making my mistakes.
one_liner: The AI-Native Benefits Brokerage

name: Pomerado
long_description:
Pomerado turns any website into an API / MCP in minutes. Connect your agents to legacy portals, consumer websites, and internal tools. 

Why Pomerado:
    • 7x faster than browser agents on customer workflows
    • 100x cheaper than browser agents
    • Self healing, deterministic APIs
    • Universal website coverage
    • Hosting, authentication, and permissions handled

Customers can use us to:
    • automate back office workflows on legacy systems (ERP, EHR, CRM)
    • speed up customer integrations for forward deployments
    • connect enterprise assistants to internal tools
    • supercharge personal assistants with fast and reliable browser use

We’re ex-McKinsey and Scale AI. We drove enterprise agent deployments at F500s and orgs like the Mayo Clinic. We saw how legacy systems block agent development and AI transformations; Pomerado turns those systems into AI-native components automatically.
one_liner: Turn any website into an MCP for your agents, in minutes

name: Polemos Industries
long_description:
Precision strike is rationed. Forces see more targets than they can afford to hit.

Polemos builds AI-guided ballistic missiles and the compact launchers that fire them, designed for mass manufacturing. Our launchers form a strike network wired into the recon drones already in the sky: a drone geolocates a target, the nearest launcher fires, and a guided round lands in seconds.

Short range, no wasted kilometers, no modified trucks. Built on production lines that already exist, so output scales when it matters most.
one_liner: AI-guided ballistic missiles, cheap enough to field in numbers that…

name: Hesper AI
long_description:
Hesper AI builds AI agents that investigate P&C insurance claims end to end.

Hesper’s agents read the claim file, detect tampered documents, verify facts, check coverage, flag inconsistencies, and produce an audit-ready case file in minutes, so insurers can check every claim. 

We work with Claims and SIU orgs at Carriers, MGAs and TPAs,
one_liner: AI Claims Investigator for Insurance

name: Reconero
long_description:
Officers join the force to protect their communities, yet over 40% of their day is eaten by paperwork that keeps them behind a desk. The burden reaches beyond lost time. Burnout is driving officers out of the force, leaving those who remain carrying an even heavier workload.

Reconero is built to give that time back. By automating reports, forms, analytics, and more, we help officers finish their administrative paperwork faster, spend more time serving their communities, and protect the time they have with their families.
one_liner: Reconero helps police officers automate their workflows with AI

name: Native
long_description: Native is building an autonomous marketing platform where business can do all of their marketing within one platform using our artificial intuition model called Norn, that predicts what people will respond to, researched and built in house.
one_liner: Artificial Intuition for marketing

name: Latent
long_description: Latent catches wrong or unsupported LLM answers before they reach your users. Instead of running a second model to check every output, it reads the model's own internal state as it generates, so every request is verified with no added latency, no extra inference cost, and nothing leaving your deployment. Teams running LLMs in production, in finance, legal, healthcare and customer support, get a review queue of the answers most likely to be wrong, calibrated to their own model and traffic, with a plain explanation of why each one was flagged.
one_liner: Catch wrong LLM answers before your customers do

name: antimattr
long_description: antimattr builds a voice-first hardware interface for human-agent interaction that includes a ring and a pair of earphones. Designed to make more of your voice, the ring can record and summarise your conversations, capture thoughts on the go, or control your agents. The earphones use proprietary voice isolation technology to block out background noise entirely, so you can take a clear call from a loud pub or dictate with real accuracy.
one_liner: voice-first hardware interface for human-agent interaction

name: Preload
long_description:
Designing and iterating a multimodal hardware stack (currently ego + tactile gloves + EMG) to collect rich and scalable datasets for physical AI. Also interested in how we can use this technology to advance surgery.

Built by PhD founders (Johns Hopkins, Caltech) with world-class expertise in brain-computer interfaces (Neuralink, Meta, Paradromics)
one_liner: Sensorimotor context for physical AI

name: Lux Foods
long_description: Lux Foods engineers ultra-compact plants that produce mostly fruit, then grows them on sugar with 90% less light. We design the biology and hardware together to make robotic farming easier. Starting with cherry tomatoes, we’re building year-round production of flavorful, nutritious, pesticide-free fruit near the people who eat it. Our tomatoes have been grown on the International Space Station, and now we're taking this technology to Earth.
one_liner: Crops engineered for premium fruit, grown without sunlight.

name: Graphide
long_description: Graphide (YC F26) is a code editor that maps your codebase into a graph so you can see what your agents are building. Agents now write code faster than anyone can read it, and a line by line diff doesn't show what actually changed in the system. Graphide keeps a live graph of the modules, classes, functions, etc. how they connect, and what each agent is touching as it works. Graphide then checks their changes against your architecture, making sure your agents are implementing what you had in mind.
one_liner: A graph based IDE for when agents program faster than you can read

name: OpEra
long_description: OpEra Technologies is the AI decision engine for factories, warehouses and fleets. Companies with physical operations make thousands of decisions every day, and we help their teams make the best one at every step from production to delivery: (1) Planning: how much to make, buy and stock. (2) Scheduling: what runs when, and who works on what. (3) Allocation: which warehouse or store gets each order. (4) Routing: boat, plane or truck, and which route each one takes. Founded out of MIT's Operations Research Center.
one_liner: The AI decision engine for factories, warehouses and fleets

name: Papaya
long_description:
Papaya is the optimization engine for AI agents. Engineers don't have time to continually improve the agents they've shipped — the context bloat, overly chatty subagents, and broken tool calls sit in production traces nobody reads, quietly hurting agent efficiency. With Papaya they connect their agent directly via SDK, get actionable recommendations on how to improve quality, latency, and cost, and the ones they approve are pushed to production as pull requests.

Papaya runs 200+ research-backed analyses across context, prompts, prompt caching, subagents, and tool calls. Every recommendation is ranked by impact and comes with the production runs that produced it — typically a 20%+ quality improvement on the first workflow analysis.
one_liner: Continuously improve the quality of your AI agents.

name: UXDuck
long_description:
Starting with a modern interface for drones that users can build on and adapt. 

Works with planes, copters, rovers, boats and submarines.

Try it in 5 seconds with simulated drones - https://uxduck.com/
one_liner: Build better drones. Run better missions.

name: Sona8
long_description:
Sona8 uses AI voice agents to interview employees about how work gets done. Consulting, transformation and corporate development teams use it to hear from more people and follow up after changes.

Employees open a link and speak in their own language. The agent asks follow-up questions, and teams compare problems across sites and departments. We’ve completed 10,000+ employee interviews and signed one of the world’s top three consulting firms.

We’re building the context layer and operating system for strategy teams: combining employee knowledge with company data to understand operations, improve processes and put decisions into action. The same context will guide AI agents as they take over work, so the company keeps what it learns.
one_liner: Voice agents survey employees to map, improve & automate workflows

name: Melty
one_liner: Mashup any game

name: Composal
long_description: Check features, not code. Composal sends a swarm of agents to use your product like your users do. They test real flows and edge cases to show you what works, what breaks, and if it’s ready to ship.
one_liner: Swarms of agents acting like users to find bugs before release

name: Epsilab
long_description: Applied AI research lab focused on RL for frontier model training. Our research and evals cover real-world environment simulation, long-horizon workflows, and multi-player agents, etc.
one_liner: Long horizon RL environments from real-life data

name: Verdun
long_description:
Traditional security camera monitoring is vaporware. Your sites aren't actually being protected. 

A monitoring center's video alarm queue is managed by operators who are flooded by alarms during peak activity - meaning it often takes 20+ minutes for them to even see your alarm.

When you call an airline and get placed on hold for a long time only for an offshore operator to tell you he can't solve your problems, this is the security equivalent. 

We've built the world's most advanced monitoring center run by AI agents identify threatening behavior and context before escalating to our highly trained professional operators to dispatch guards and police.
one_liner: The world's most advanced security monitoring service

name: Caveman
long_description: Caveman is the optimization stack for AI agents. It observes real agent workloads, finds cost and performance inefficiencies, tests improvements, and safely deploys the ones that work.
one_liner: Caveman cuts what AI agents cost without making them dumber.

name: Blinka
long_description:
Blinka is banking for US companies operating globally.

Our customers incorporate in the US but run their operations, teams, and vendors from other countries. They use Blinka as their primary operating account.

With Blinka, companies can:

- Open a USD business account without being in the US.
- Send money abroad without the usual 4–5% FX fees.
- Earn yield on treasuries.
- Issue global corporate cards with 1.5% cash back and 0 international fees.
- Manage their financial operations with our AI tools.
one_liner: Banking for US companies operating globally

name: Volaren Inc.
long_description:
Volaren is an agent for your portfolio that explains each move, suggests your next idea, and trades it for you. 

Connect your bank accounts & brokerage and Volaren tells you what changed and why, answers any question about your money, and turns any idea into a trade. You can copy the moves of famous investors, politicians, proven strategies and themed baskets in a tap, or set up your own AI agents to watch the market and act within the limits you choose. 

Everything works from the app, the web or a simple text, so managing your money feels like texting a portfolio manager who never sleeps.
one_liner: The investing agent that comes to you

name: Terse
long_description: We build infrastructure to power agentic systems such as software factories, multiplayer agent frameworks and agent coordination.
one_liner: Durable state for AI agents

name: Frontrunner
long_description:
Build agents that research accounts, find prospects, run campaigns, update your CRM, qualify inbound, and more. Connect them to the systems you already use and let them work alongside your GTM team.

Engineer your revenue factory on Frontrunner.
one_liner: Cursor for GTM

name: Decent
long_description: Decent is a health insurance brokerage for small businesses. We compare every way to cover your team, show what each one costs, and then keep improving your plan all year. We're paid by insurance companies, so we're free to you.
one_liner: Your health plan should get better year-round. Not just once a year.

name: Cyclon
long_description: Cyclon is rebuilding the phone around AI. Instead of opening apps and tapping through screens, you tell your phone what you want and it does it for you. With one touch, you can spin up AI agents to control your phone or handle tasks in the background. AI isn’t just inside an app - it’s the phone itself.
one_liner: a phone where AI is the interface

name: Ageospatial
long_description:
Ageospatial helps organizations value the risk on their physical assets (properties, land, infrastructure) remotely using satellite imagery.

97% of commercial properties are never physically inspected because it's too slow and expensive. So insurers price risk based on what the client or broker tells them, and about half the time at least one of those records is wrong. The result is mispricing, fraud, and an estimated $36B in premium leakage every year in the US alone, which gets exposed the moment a disaster hits.

Upload a list of addresses and their GeoAI reads satellite and street-level imagery, maps, real-time data, public records and the insurer's own data to determine what's really there, which natural and human hazards surround it, what changed over time, and which properties are worth inspecting. Each property becomes a living record that underwriting, claims and pricing teams can trace from past to present. Ageospatial deploys inside carriers and MGAs as an AI-native service, so insurers get outcomes delivered.
one_liner: Physical intelligence for every decision with Geospatial AI.

name: The Agentic Data Co.
long_description: We design and collect audio datasets for training speech models.
one_liner: Training Data For Speech Models.

name: Redoubt Insurance
long_description: Redoubt is a commercial insurance agency for small businesses. We believe our customers are our most important business partners, and they deserve our full attention. Machines can already handle the boring parts, the next step is to continually learn from experience.
one_liner: Commercial insurance for small businesses

name: Lark
long_description:
Lark deploys AI agents for distributors to automate purchasing, demand forecasting, inventory monitoring, sales operations, and data analysis.

Our agents connect to the ERP, CRM, email, spreadsheets, and other software your team already uses. They forecast demand, prepare purchase orders, flag inventory issues, update sales records, and answer questions using your business data. Together, these agents can run a distributor’s entire operation.

We handle setup and tailor each agent to your workflows, business rules, and approval limits, so your team can automate recurring work while staying in control.
one_liner: AI agents that automate workflows for distributors

name: Tilo
long_description:
Tilo is a Linux-based operating system built for AI agents to work alongside people. On Tilo, computer use is up to 10,000x cheaper than on a normal OS.

Today agents use computers the way people do. They take screenshots and click through apps, which is slow, expensive, and brittle. In Tilo, every app exports actions, so agents work over MCP while people use the UI. You still see what each agent does in your apps, and anything it changes can be undone.

Any number of people and agents can work in one workspace in real time, across apps. Tilo runs as your OS, in our cloud, or headless on your machine, and you can open and share any workspace from the browser.
one_liner: A Linux-based, AI-native operating system.

name: Kiwi
long_description: While engineering teams have become fully AI-native, GTM teams have fallen behind. Teams struggle with continuous enablement of their teams, keeping context, agent skills, and connectors up to date with shifting GTM states and strategies, as well as accuracy, when operators can't trust their agents because the data is incomplete, inconsistent, or unreliable. With Kiwi, every agent is self-improving, and cites the SQL query and data snapshot pulled from the Kiwi GTM brain used to produce every output. Kiwi enables GTM teams to be fully AI-native.
one_liner: Kiwi is your GTM agent's favorite data engineer.

name: OpenHack
long_description: OpenHack is an always on AI Security Engineer. OpenHack understands your business, system design and developer intent like a real security engineer. It ingests all this context to find the hardest vulnerabilities through AI codebase scanning, AI pentesting and Supply Chain Security. It verifies and prioritizes vulnerabilities automatically, and filters out false positives like a real security engineer drastically reducing overhead.
one_liner: Always-on AI security engineer

long_description:

Next: Performance · Security. DM if you need either.

name: Phone Harness
long_description: Phone Harness is the most popular open-source harness for phone automation with 3,800+ GitHub stars. We enable agents to tap, type, and scroll on your personal phone or cloud-hosted phones. Supports iPhone and Android. No jailbreak, API, or app installation needed.
one_liner: Let your agent control your phone

name: Wondersearch
long_description:
Our mission is to give every AI agent the right context, from any amount of data.

WonderSearch is search built for AI agents. We let developers make all of their data searchable by meaning, without embeddings, servers or ingestion, so agents can pull the right context and cite where it came from. Unlike vector databases and RAG stacks, there's no pipeline to build or maintain: connect your files and data, and they're searchable right away. It runs on our own search model, and you pay only per query, whatever the size of your data.

Teams use WonderSearch across their own documents and knowledge, and build it into their products, help centres and AI features, connecting through MCP, our API, the CLI or the Python SDK.

(Evokoa, Inc. is the company behind WonderSearch.)
one_liner: Instant semantic search over your data without embeddings.

$500B+ a year is spent to keep machines running in the US, we're coming for all of it.
